profiles.name: Basic Mob
profiles.description: Weak foes that find strength and courage in numbers, fighting alongside their stronger allies.
profiles.traitsText: Weak foes that find strength and courage in numbers, fighting alongside their stronger allies.

abilities.name: Rabble
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Target foe takes 2 damage once again for every other mob member in adjacent spaces to them, up to three times.

abilities.name: Rush
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Up to three members in any order may dash 2, then deal 1 damage to a foe and shove them 1 space.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Up to three allies adjacent to a member may dash 1 space, or one ally adjacent to a member may dash 3 spaces.

profiles.name: Warrior
profiles.description: Simple, hard-hitting melee fighter that attacks multiple foes at once.
profiles.traitsText: Simple, hard-hitting melee fighter that attacks multiple foes at once.

abilities.name: Redondo
abilities.rulesText: Swap places with an adjacent ally, removing and placing both characters.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: All foes adjacent to the warrior or its attack target take fray damage.

abilities.name: Bull rush
abilities.rulesText: The Warrior rushes 1. An adjacent character when it finishes its movement is either weakened or shoved 1.

profiles.name: Soldier
profiles.description: Basic melee fighter, controls the flow of combat with deft strikes and slashes.
profiles.traitsText: Basic melee fighter, controls the flow of combat with deft strikes and slashes.

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] + fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is slashed.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe is shoved 2.

abilities.name: Valiant
abilities.rulesText: The soldier rushes up to 4 spaces in a straight line, then may use Bash as a free action

profiles.name: Impaler
profiles.description: A fighter that pushes around characters and keeps them pinned and at arm’s length.
profiles.traitsText: A fighter that pushes around characters and keeps them pinned and at arm’s length. Special Traits: Sturdy

abilities.name: Advance
abilities.rulesText: Rush 1.

abilities.name: Spike
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray and shove 2. Miss: fray and shove 1. Collide: Foe is slashed.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, range 2, true strike, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray and shove 4. The Impaler rushes 3 towards the foe after shoving them. Miss: fray and shove 2. Collide: foe is slashed and stunned.

profiles.name: Greatsword
profiles.description: Straightforward, hard hitting foe that attacks with sweeping, heavy attacks.
profiles.traitsText: Straightforward, hard hitting foe that attacks with sweeping, heavy attacks.

abilities.name: Weapon Vault
abilities.rulesText: The Greatsword targets a character in range 2, then removes itself from the battlefield and places itself in any space adjacent to that character. Then, it may shove that character 1.

abilities.name: Great Slice
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Rush 1. On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Slash attack target.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.header: 2 actions, melee, attack, true strike, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray damage. Effect: The Greatsword rushes 1 space, three times. After it rushes, each time, it deals 2 damage to adjacent characters.

profiles.name: Brute
profiles.description: Large foe that can hurl allies and enemies around.
profiles.traitsText: Large foe that can hurl allies and enemies around. Special Traits: Sturdy, Size 2

abilities.name: Backhand
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray.

abilities.name: Backbreaker
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is stunned. Effect: Brute may rush 2 before using this ability.

abilities.name: Bulk up
abilities.rulesText: Gain 4 vigor, or 6 if bloodied.

abilities.name: Hurl
abilities.rulesText: The Brute shoves an adjacent character or object 2. Collide: Character is weakened.

profiles.name: Knuckle
profiles.description: Heavily armored foe that taunts opponents and can strike multiple opponents at once
profiles.traitsText: Heavily armored foe that taunts opponents and can strike multiple opponents at once Heavy Armor: Resistant to damage from adjacent spaces

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: All foes adjacent to the attack target take 2 damage

abilities.name: Crushing Advance
abilities.rulesText: The Knuckle and all allies in range 2 may rush 1 space. Then, all foes adjacent to the Knuckle take 2 damage.

abilities.name: Call out
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range 3 must save or be shoved 2 towards the knuckle, then gain hatred of the knuckle. On a successful save, they are shoved 1 towards the knuckle.

profiles.name: Berserker
profiles.description: A reckless fighter that becomes more powerful when taking damage.
profiles.traitsText: A reckless fighter that becomes more powerful when taking damage. Special Traits: Defiance Enrage: While bloody, gain +1 action

abilities.name: Bloody crescent
abilities.header: 1 actions, true strike, attack, arc 3, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Attack target is slashed.

abilities.name: Full Moon
abilities.rulesText: , combo): On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Berserker gains 4 vigor.

abilities.name: Furious Leap
abilities.rulesText: The berserker flies 2, then foes adjacent to the berserker take 2 damage.

profiles.name: Sentinel
profiles.description: Foe that uses its reach and alert senses to defend an area.
profiles.traitsText: Foe that uses its reach and alert senses to defend an area.

abilities.name: Trip
abilities.rulesText: A foe is shoved 1 in any direction.

abilities.name: Sweep
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+ fray. Miss or area effect: fray. s Shove 1

abilities.name: Fortress
abilities.rulesText: The Sentinel may rush 1, then gains aura 1 until the start of its next turn. While this aura is active: • The Sentinel gains counter • Allies without this ability in the aura gain resistance. • Any foe that enters the area without being shoved takes 3 damage, but no more than once a turn.

profiles.name: Crusher
profiles.description: Foe that uses its great strength to grapple or pin down its enemies
profiles.traitsText: Foe that uses its great strength to grapple or pin down its enemies Special Traits: Sturdy

abilities.name: Headbutt
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is weakened. Effect: Deals bonus damage to weakened foes.

abilities.name: Mighty Blow
abilities.rulesText: The Crusher deals 2 damage to an adjacent foe and either shoves them 1 or creates a pit under them.

abilities.name: Grapple
abilities.rulesText: The Crusher marks an adjacent foe. While marked, that foe must save if it attempts to break adjacency. On a failed save, it becomes unable to exit adjacency with the Crusher by any means for the rest of the current turn. On a successful save, the mark and this effect ends, but the foe is weakened.

profiles.name: Sledge
profiles.description: Hard hitting foe that inflicts stun with a heavy blow.
profiles.traitsText: Hard hitting foe that inflicts stun with a heavy blow. Bullheaded: Has resistance unless suffering from a status.

abilities.name: Chain hook
abilities.rulesText: A character in range 3 is shoved 2 towards the Sledge.

abilities.name: Shoulder check
abilities.rulesText: Rush 1. An adjacent foe is shoved 1.

abilities.name: Crushing Overhead
abilities.rulesText: Attack: On hit: 3[D] +fray and foe is stunned and shoved 1. Miss: fray damage and foe is slashed. Effect: Deals bonus damage to slashed or weakened characters.

profiles.name: Pepperbox
profiles.description: A mobile ranged attacker that hits multiple times with a short bow or gun.
profiles.traitsText: A mobile ranged attacker that hits multiple times with a short bow or gun.

abilities.name: Riddle
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 3 damage, three times. Miss: 3 damage. Effect: Against foes at exactly range 3, inflicts dazed and gains unerring.

abilities.name: Strafe
abilities.rulesText: The Pepperbox dashes 2, then deals 2 damage to a foe in range 3.

abilities.name: Flash Bomb
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: All foes take 3 damage twice and are blinded. Effect: If the Pepperbox catches itself or allies in the area, they gain stealth.

profiles.name: Hunter
profiles.description: A skilled ranged attacker that hunts down and eliminates single targets.
profiles.traitsText: A skilled ranged attacker that hunts down and eliminates single targets. Wayfinding: Has evasion while inside difficult or dangerous terrain, and ignores the effects of difficult or dangerous terrain.

abilities.name: Hunter shot
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Bloodied characters are shoved 1 in a direction of the Hunter’s choice and dazed.

abilities.name: Set Trap
abilities.rulesText: The Hunter creates a trap dangerous terrain space in free space in range 2.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.rulesText: Dash 1 and gain stealth

abilities.name: Hunt
abilities.rulesText: A character in range is marked. The hunter deals bonus damage to the marked character and their abilities gain unerring against them.

profiles.name: Fencer
profiles.description: A mobile melee fighter that is an excellent duelist.
profiles.traitsText: A mobile melee fighter that is an excellent duelist.

abilities.name: Iron Kiss
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray, Miss: fray. Effect: May dash 3 after the attack.

abilities.name: Skewer
abilities.rulesText: Dash up to 3 spaces in a straight line, then deal damage to an adjacent foe equal to the number of spaces moved +2.

abilities.name: Duel
abilities.rulesText: Mark a character in range. Gain evasion against the marked character, and when the marked character uses an ability, may dash 1 after the ability resolves. End the mark if the marked character hits the Fencer with an attack.

profiles.name: Assassin
profiles.description: A fighter that attacks in sweeping bursts.
profiles.traitsText: A fighter that attacks in sweeping bursts. Nimble: Has evasion unless suffering from a status

abilities.name: Razor Wind
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]. Miss: 1 damage. Effect: Repeat the following effect twice: Dash 1, then area effect: burst 1(self): 2 damage

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.rulesText: The Assassin or an ally in range may fly 2.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.rulesText: The Assassin chooses a foe in range. At the end of that foe’s turn, as long as they’re in range 3, teleport to any space adjacent to them, deal 2 damage, three times to them, and blind them. Reduce this damage to just 2 damage if they have an adjacent ally. Then, fly 1.

profiles.name: Hellion
profiles.description: A flying combatant that is more powerful against solitary foes.
profiles.traitsText: A flying combatant that is more powerful against solitary foes. Special Traits: Flying

abilities.name: Rake:
abilities.rulesText: On Hit: [D] + fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Hellion can fly to any point on the line after the ability resolves. Foes in the area must save or be dazed.

abilities.name: Pinions
abilities.rulesText: Deal 2 damage three times to a foe in range. Reduce this damage by one instance for every ally of that foe in range 2 of them.

abilities.name: Swoop
abilities.rulesText: Leave the battlefield. Return to the battlefield in a visible free space at the end of the very next player turn with stealth.

profiles.name: Skulk
profiles.description: A sneaky foe that hits hard against weakened foes. phasing.
profiles.traitsText: A sneaky foe that hits hard against weakened foes. Sneak: While in stealth, has evasion and phasing.

abilities.name: Sneaky Stab
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray, Miss: fray. Effect: Attack deals bonus damage to and does not break stealth against bloodied or blinded foes.

abilities.name: Throwing Knife
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range takes damage equal to its distance from the skulk.

abilities.name: Blinding Dust
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe becomes blinded. The Skulk then may dash 2 and gains stealth.

profiles.name: Shadow
profiles.description: A foe that becomes vastly more powerful when attacking from stealth. Can cross great distances instantly.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that becomes vastly more powerful when attacking from stealth. Can cross great distances instantly. Special Traits: Phasing

abilities.name: Shadow Cloak
abilities.rulesText: The Shadow teleports 4, then gains stealth.

abilities.name: Shadow Scour
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, unerring, range 4, +1 boon, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+2, twice. Miss: [D]+ fray, once. Effect: Blinds foe. Effect: Deals bonus damage to bloodied or blinded foes.

abilities.name: Dark Arts
abilities.rulesText: Swap places with a character in range, teleporting. Foes can save to avoid this effect.

abilities.name: Smothering darkness
abilities.rulesText: The Shadow creates a darkness terrain effect in a single space in range. The area is dangerous terrain for foes, and foes inside are blinded+.

profiles.name: Arsonist
profiles.description: A fighter that uses bombs to disrupt the battlefield.
profiles.traitsText: A fighter that uses bombs to disrupt the battlefield.

abilities.name: Bomb
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray, Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: If only one character is caught in the area of effect, deal 2 damage again to that character and they are dazed.

abilities.name: Kick Off
abilities.rulesText: The Arsonist flies 1. Before they fly, they may shove an adjacent character 1 space, then deal 2 damage to them if they are a foe. If they do, they fly 3 instead.

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.rulesText: The Arsonist sticks a bomb at a character in range. At the end of that character’s turn, the bomb explodes and they take 2 damage four times. For every adjacent foe or ally, reduce the number of times the targeted character takes damage by one, but deal 2 damage instead to that character. Then, end this effect.

profiles.name: Errant
profiles.description: A holy warrior that can intervene and save nearby allies from harm.
profiles.traitsText: A holy warrior that can intervene and save nearby allies from harm.

abilities.name: Shining Sword
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] + fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is pacified. Effect: Damage from this ability does not break pacified.

abilities.name: Intervention
abilities.rulesText: The Errant gains the following interrupt until the start of its next turn. If this interrupt is unused at the start of their turn, the errant can teleport 3 instead. Intervene: Interrupt 1 Trigger: An ally in range 3 is targeted by an ability. Effect: The ally gains resistance against that ability and +1 boon on any saves against it. The errant may then teleport adjacent to that ally.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe is teleported 1 space, then the errant and all its allies in range 3 of that foe can teleport 1 space towards the foe.

profiles.name: Priest
profiles.description: Divinely infused foes with the power to shield allies from harm.
profiles.traitsText: Divinely infused foes with the power to shield allies from harm. Special Traits: Defiance

abilities.name: Holy
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: [D] + fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Attack target is pacified. Effect: Allies in the area gain 2 vigor

abilities.name: Pandaemonium
abilities.rulesText: The Priest targets a large blast area in range. It may remove all characters in the area, then place them back in any other space in the area. Foes can save to avoid this effect, but are sealed on a successful save.

abilities.name: Shield of Faith
abilities.rulesText: Allied character in range becomes marked. When marked, the ally is cured. While marked and in range of the priest, the marked ally has resistance and +1 boon on saves.

profiles.name: Commander
profiles.description: Martial leaders that are excellent at moving allies around.
profiles.traitsText: Martial leaders that are excellent at moving allies around. Commander’s Aura: Aura 2. Allies in the aura have +1 boon on attacks.

abilities.name: Leader’s strike
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Up to two allies in range 3 can dash 2 spaces and gain 2 vigor.

abilities.name: Coordinate Strikes
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range takes 2 damage once for every ally of the commander adjacent to them, up to three times.

abilities.name: Marching Orders
abilities.rulesText: When Commander takes this stance, as an action while in this stance, and at start of each of the commander’s turns, the commander and all allies in range 2 can dash 2 in the same direction, or as far as possible.

profiles.name: Abjurer
profiles.description: A defensive expert that protects nearby allies with a powerful shield.
profiles.traitsText: A defensive expert that protects nearby allies with a powerful shield. Aura of Shielding: Aura 1. The abjurer and allies in the area have dodge

abilities.name: Cleansing Bolt
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: fray damage. Miss or area Effect: fray. Effect: Does not damage allies. Deals bonus damage for each ally caught in its area of effect.

abilities.name: Cleansing Charm
abilities.rulesText: The Abjurer places a charm in a free space in range. An ally that ends their turn adjacent to the charm can consume it to cure themselves and fly 2.

abilities.name: Empower Shield
abilities.rulesText: The Abjurer becomes immobile, but their aura of shielding increases to aura 2 and also grants cover from abilities used from outside the aura. They can exit this stance as an action.

profiles.name: Diviner
profiles.description: A fortune teller that relies on allies, fate, and the power of the stars to set up attacks.
profiles.traitsText: A fortune teller that relies on allies, fate, and the power of the stars to set up attacks.

abilities.name: Divination
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: 1 damage and the foe is marked. Mark: A card attaches to the target. The next time the target is damaged by an attack, the card explodes in a small blast area effect explosion centered on them for [D]+fray. Foes within must save or become sealed. Then, the mark clears.

abilities.name: Dark Fate
abilities.rulesText: The Abjurer chooses a foe in range. That foe is either pacified (1-3) and shoved 1 away from them, or sealed (4-6) and shoved 1 towards them.

abilities.name: Bend Fate
abilities.rulesText: The Abjurer chooses an ally in range, then gambles, applying the effect: 1. Ally deals fray damage to all adjacent characters. 2. Ally may teleport 4 3. Ally gains flying for the rest of combat. 4. Ally gains stealth 5. Ally creates 3 spaces of difficult terrain in adjacent spaces. 6. Ally becomes unstoppable until bloodied, or until defeated if already bloodied.

profiles.name: Greenseer
profiles.description: A foe that draws upon the natural world to call forth overgrowth to hinder and harm their enemies.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that draws upon the natural world to call forth overgrowth to hinder and harm their enemies.

abilities.name: Greenwrath
abilities.rulesText: Attack: On hit [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage and inflicts sealed if a character is inside dangerous or difficult terrain.

abilities.name: Vine lash
abilities.rulesText: A character in range is shoved 2 in any direction. If they move into difficult terrain during this shove, they take 3 piercing damage.

abilities.name: Healing Spore
abilities.rulesText: The Greenseer creates a spore terrain effect in range. Foes are pacified+ while adjacent to the spore, and the spore grants 2 vigor to all adjacent allies when created. Only one spore can be created at once.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.rulesText: Terrain effect: Create a small blast area of difficult terrain. The difficult terrain provides cover for allies from abilities from the outside.

profiles.name: Judge
profiles.description: A tough foe that protects allies with a portable shrine and martial arts.
profiles.traitsText: A tough foe that protects allies with a portable shrine and martial arts.

abilities.name: Justice Fist
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray. Miss: fray damage. Effect: Foe is sealed. Shove 1 and deal bonus damage against sealed characters. Collide: Foe is stunned.

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.rulesText: Effect: A character in range 4 takes 1 piercing damage. If that character attacks before the end of their next turn, they take [D]+fray piercing damage again and this effect ends.

abilities.name: Shrine of Sanctuary
abilities.rulesText: Summon a height 1 shrine destructible object in range (10 HP, attacks automatically hit). While adjacent to the shrine, allies have resistance and gain +1 boon on attacks.

profiles.name: Saint
profiles.description: A pacifistic foe that prefers to prevent any violence from happening at all.
profiles.traitsText: A pacifistic foe that prefers to prevent any violence from happening at all. Martyrdom: When defeated, cures all allies in range 2.

abilities.name: Starcall
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: [D]+fray and foe is pacified. Area effect: fray. Effect: Foe explodes for a burst 2 (target) area effect, dealing 3 damage to all foes within and granting 3 vigor to all allies.

abilities.name: Gentleness
abilities.rulesText: The Saint becomes immobile and gains aura 2 until the start of its next turn. While in the aura, all characters gain +1 curse on attacks and take 1 divine damage each time they deal damage to another character with an ability. Allies at 25% hp or lower than end their turn in the aura are cured.

abilities.name: Immaculate
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range 5 becomes immune to all damage until the end of its next turn.

profiles.name: Cantrix
profiles.description: A charismatic foe that can strongly empower a single ally with the power of their voice.
profiles.traitsText: A charismatic foe that can strongly empower a single ally with the power of their voice.

abilities.name: Discord
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: Fray damage.

abilities.name: Chant of investiture
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range is marked by the Cantrix and gains resistance, sturdy, and +1 boon on all attacks and saves. While in this stance, the Cantrix is immobile and must spend 1 action during their turn to maintain this stance. It ends if the Cantrix takes damage.

abilities.name: Hypnogogia
abilities.rulesText: A character in range 8 of the Cantrix becomes pacified. If already pacified, the character becomes unable to dash, rush, or fly until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.rulesText: The Cantrix swaps place with a marked ally, removing and placing both of them.

profiles.name: Blaster
profiles.description: A fiery foe that hurls blasts that greatly harm grouped up enemies.
profiles.traitsText: A fiery foe that hurls blasts that greatly harm grouped up enemies.

abilities.name: Blast
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray damage. Area Effect: Deal 1 piercing damage again to all characters for each character caught in the area, up to a maximum of three times. Effect: At round 3+, increase blast to a large blast and deals bonus damage

abilities.name: Emberflash
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: 2 piercing damage and create a dangerous terrain space in the center, which can be placed under a character.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.rulesText: A character in range 6 becomes vulnerable. Vulnerable foes are shoved 2 and take 1 piercing damage twice.

profiles.name: Seismatist
profiles.description: A foe that draws on earth aether to create terrain and smash enemies.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that draws on earth aether to create terrain and smash enemies. Earth Bond: Resistance when adjacent to an object or inside a pit.

abilities.name: Rumble
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]. Miss or area effect: 1 damage. Effect: Releases a medium blast on the attack target as an area effect, dealing 3 piercing damage again. Effect: Deals bonus damage for every object or pit in the area. Effect: At round 3+, stuns any character on an object or inside a pit in the area.

abilities.name: Seismic Rumble
abilities.rulesText: Characters are shoved 1 in the direction of the line, in any order. Collide: Character is shattered and takes 1 piercing damage twice

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.rulesText: Summon a height 1 boulder object or a a pit in free space in range 6.

profiles.name: Storm Caller
profiles.description: A foe that draws on water aether to summon a storm and deny a large area of the battlefield.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that draws on water aether to summon a storm and deny a large area of the battlefield. Special Traits: Flying

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.header: 1 actions, attack, range 8, small blast, pierce
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Summon a pit in a free space in the area.

abilities.name: Frozen Spear
abilities.rulesText: The first character in the line takes 2 piercing damage twice and is shattered. All other foes take 2 piercing damage.

abilities.name: Summon Storm
abilities.rulesText: Summon a medium blast terrain effect in range. The area is difficult terrain for foes and while inside, foes are vulnerable+. Allies have flying while inside. The storm caller can redirect any of its storms with 1 action, moving them up to 3 spaces, then dealing fray damage to any characters in their area. Effect: At round 3+, becomes 1 action

profiles.name: Rift Dancer
profiles.description: A foe that uses lightning aether to zip around the battlefield and harass enemies.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that uses lightning aether to zip around the battlefield and harass enemies.

abilities.name: Dissonant Bolt
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Attack target is vulnerable. Effect: Foes in the line may be teleported 1. Effect: At round 3+, increase this teleport to 2 and deal 2 piercing damage again to foes teleported this way

abilities.name: Flash step
abilities.rulesText: Teleport 1, then either Teleport 2, or deal 2 piercing damage to a foe in range 3

abilities.name: Crackling Rift
abilities.rulesText: The Rift Dancer creates a line 3 dangerous terrain effect in range 4. Allies are immune to damage from the effect and can teleport 1 if they end their turn in the area. Foes are vulnerable+ while in the area.

profiles.name: Chaos Wright
profiles.description: A foe that can inflict a high number of blights, enabling its allies.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that can inflict a high number of blights, enabling its allies. Special Traits: Phasing

abilities.name: Chaos Shard
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray, Miss: Fray. Effect: Foe is shattered.

abilities.name: Destabilize Matter
abilities.rulesText: The Chaos wright marks a character in range. While marked, the chaos wright may teleport that character 2 spaces at the start of their turn. A foe can save at the end of their turns to clear this mark.

abilities.name: Chaos Rift
abilities.rulesText: Create a pit in free space in range. The pit is also dangerous terrain, and characters cannot attack while inside. The Chaos wright is immune to damage and effects from its chaos rifts, and can teleport to the location of any active rift in range 3 as a free action during its turn.

abilities.name: Chaos Storm
abilities.rulesText: Teleport all characters 2 spaces. Foes take 2 piercing damage as an area effect. Effect: At round 3+, becomes 1 action.

profiles.name: Disruptor
profiles.description: A foe that relies on magnetic power to move around its enemies.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that relies on magnetic power to move around its enemies.

abilities.name: Magnetism
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: Fray. Effect: All characters in range 2 of the foe are shoved 1 towards or away from that character (Disruptor chooses). Effect: At round 3+, deals bonus damage and shatters all foes targeted.

abilities.name: Anchor
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range 6 is shoved up to 4 spaces towards the Disruptor with phasing.

abilities.name: Disrupt
abilities.rulesText: A character in range 8 is marked. While marked, they are vulnerable+ and take 1 piercing damage, once, for every adjacent character every time they end their turn. If they end their turn with no characters adjacent, end this mark.

profiles.name: Scourer
profiles.description: A foe that uses bursts of overwhelming power to focus down one enemy and deny them shelter.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that uses bursts of overwhelming power to focus down one enemy and deny them shelter.

abilities.name: Scour
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Mark the target. Attacks against the marked target for the rest of combat gain +1 boon, deal bonus damage, ignore cover, and inflict shattered. This effect does not stack. Effect: At round 3+, this effect can mark any number of targets.

abilities.name: Boiling Bolus
abilities.rulesText: Create a medium blast terrain effect in range. Characters in the area take piercing fray damage as an area effect when the area is created. The area is difficult and dangerous terrain and new objects or terrain effects cannot be created in the area. The area lasts until this ability is used again.

profiles.name: Sapper
profiles.description: A foe that throws out arcing blasts of energy.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that throws out arcing blasts of energy.

abilities.name: Chain Bolt
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Area effect: One or two different foes in range 4 from the target foe also take 2 piercing damage.

abilities.name: Entrench
abilities.rulesText: The Sapper puts down a siege rune under itself, or in an adjacent space. While standing in a siege rune, the Sapper or its allies deal bonus damage, and their attacks shove 1 and inflict vulnerable on their attack target.

abilities.name: Fell Shot
abilities.header: 1 action, terrain effect, range 8, end turn
abilities.rulesText: Choose one or two free spaces in range. Terrain Effect: Characters that enter that space or start their turn there are struck by a projectile, taking 2 piercing damage twice, and ending this effect. Otherwise, it expires if the Sapper is defeated.

profiles.name: Alchemist
profiles.description: A foe that uses chemical power to dissolve and disrupt enemy formations.
profiles.traitsText: A foe that uses chemical power to dissolve and disrupt enemy formations. Insulated: Immune to damage from terrain and terrain effects

abilities.name: Spray
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Area Effect: Attack target explodes, shoving adjacent characters 1 away from them and dealing 2 piercing damage to them

abilities.name: Volatile Mix
abilities.rulesText: The Alchemist chooses a foe in range. At the end of that foe’s next turn, they explode, taking 2 piercing damage and dealing 2 piercing damage in a large blast area effect centered on themselves.

abilities.name: Sticky solution
abilities.rulesText: A character in range must save. On a successful save, they are shattered. On a failed save, they are shattered and cannot target adjacent characters or spaces with abilities until the end of their next turn.

profiles.name: Justicar
profiles.description: A strong artillery foe that punishes its enemies for keeping their distance.
profiles.traitsText: A strong artillery foe that punishes its enemies for keeping their distance.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: At round 3+, increase area to large blast and deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Mighty Summoning
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range 4 is removed from the battlefield, then placed in any space adjacent to the Justicar. Alternately, the Justicar can remove any adjacent ally, then place them in any space in range 4.

abilities.name: Riven
abilities.rulesText: Choose a foe in range 8. At the end of that character’s turn, they take 3 piercing damage, once, for every 3 spaces of distance between them and the Justicar.

profiles.name: Sniper
profiles.description: A hard hitting, simple artillery foe that can do high damage every other turn if left alone.
profiles.traitsText: A hard hitting, simple artillery foe that can do high damage every other turn if left alone.

abilities.name: Aim
abilities.rulesText: The Sniper ends its turn

abilities.name: Heart Seeker
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 3[D]+fray. Miss: [D]+fray. Effect: Cannot target characters in range 3. Effect: At round 3+, costs only 1 action and deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.rulesText: Create a 1 space terrain effect underneath the Sniper. While standing in a brace, the Sniper ignores height disadvantage and deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Grappling Hook
abilities.rulesText: The Sniper flies 2. It may fly 4 if it ends its turn in a brace.

profiles.name: Archon
profiles.description: Archons are armored, tough warriors that can be used to represent particularly hardy fighters, military leaders, or warlords. Alternately, they can be used to represent particularly ruthless or tough monsters.
profiles.traitsText: Archons are armored, tough warriors that can be used to represent particularly hardy fighters, military leaders, or warlords. Alternately, they can be used to represent particularly ruthless or tough monsters. HP: 80 Elite: Takes 2 turns Special Traits: Sturdy Enrage: +1 action while bloodied

abilities.name: Blackheart
abilities.rulesText: On hit: Deal [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Gains +1 boon and deals bonus damage for each of the following: character is stunned, slashed, or weakened.

abilities.name: Dark Edge
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray and shove 2. Miss: or area effect: [D]+fray and shove 1. Collide: Foe is weakened.

abilities.name: Iron Blades
abilities.rulesText: Effect: An adjacent foe is slashed, if they are already slashed, they take 2 damage.

abilities.name: Great Slam
abilities.rulesText: Rush 2 spaces, then all adjacent foes are shoved 1 space. Collide: foe is weakened.

abilities.name: Great Shieldwall
abilities.rulesText: While in this stance, becomes immobile, but attacks against adjacent allies gain +1 curse and adjacent allies have resistanc e. Ends at the start of the Archon’s next turn.

profiles.name: Rogue
profiles.description: Rogues are quick witted and quick on their feet. They can be used to represent skilled thieves, scouts, or assassins, or particularly agile or bloodthirsty monsters.
profiles.traitsText: Rogues are quick witted and quick on their feet. They can be used to represent skilled thieves, scouts, or assassins, or particularly agile or bloodthirsty monsters. HP: 56 Speed: 5 (Dash 5) Elite: Takes 2 turns Slippery: Has Evasion while bloodied.

abilities.name: Disappearing Act
abilities.rulesText: Trigger: When bloodied. Effect: Remove self from the battlefield. At the start of the Rogue’s next turn, return them to the battlefield anywhere in range 3 of a character, with stealth.

abilities.name: Wicked Slice
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Deals 2 damage again to the target for each of the following on the target: bloodied, blinded, dazed. Effect: Dash 1 before and after the attack

abilities.name: Blinding Dust
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe becomes blinded. The Rogue then may dash 3 and gains stealth.

abilities.name: Dirty Fighting
abilities.rulesText: Daze two foes in range 3 of the Rogue and each other, then swap their places, removing and placing them.

abilities.name: Foul Play
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Teleport 4, then deal 4 damage to an adjacent foe. Can repeat this effect, but must choose a different foe in range each time unless a foe has already been chosen by this ability, or this effect has triggered three times.

profiles.name: Scion
profiles.description: A scion is invested with holy power, to protect its allies and punish its foes. It can be used to represent high priests, temple guardians, or monsters touched by some sort of divine power.
profiles.traitsText: A scion is invested with holy power, to protect its allies and punish its foes. It can be used to represent high priests, temple guardians, or monsters touched by some sort of divine power. HP: 80 Elite: Takes 2 turns Gran Diaga: Aura 2. At the start of the scion’s turn, all allies in the aura gain vigor 3

abilities.name: Great Holy
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: [D] + Fray. Miss or area effect: Fray. Effect: Attack target is pacified. Effect: Allies in the area gain 3 vigor.

abilities.name: Denial
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range must save or become unable to attack until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take 2 damage and are sealed instead.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.rulesText: The Scion or an ally in range may fly 2.

abilities.name: Blessed Ground
abilities.rulesText: The Scion creates a space of Blessed Ground in range. The Scion and allies have resistance and deal bonus damage while inside. The spaces disappear if the Scion is defeated, and it may have a maximum of four, choosing which to keep and end.

abilities.name: Immaculate
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range 5 becomes Intangible until the end of its next turn.

profiles.name: Crucible
profiles.description: A crucible is a foe brimming with aetheric power, and could be used to represent a master wright, a war mage, or a monster that can draw upon magical forces or blasts of energy.
profiles.traitsText: A crucible is a foe brimming with aetheric power, and could be used to represent a master wright, a war mage, or a monster that can draw upon magical forces or blasts of energy. HP: 56 Special Traits: Flying Elite: Takes 2 turns

abilities.name: Unstable reality
abilities.rulesText: Self or an ally in range 3 may teleport 2

abilities.name: Annihilate
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, range 10, medium blast, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: [D]+fray. Effect: Attack target becomes vulnerable. Terrain effect: Create a pit under target. Effect: At round 3+, increase blast size to large blast, and deals 2 piercing damage again to all foes on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Great Slip
abilities.rulesText: Remove self from the battlefield, then return in a free space in range 3

abilities.name: Fell Shot
abilities.rulesText: Mark an unoccupied space in range. Area effect: Characters that enter that space or start their turn there are struck by a projectile, taking 2 piercing damage twice, and ending this effect.

abilities.name: Liminal Arrows
abilities.rulesText: Choose a foe in line of sight and range. At the end of that character’s turn, it takes piercing fray damage 3 times if not in cover from the Crucible, or just piercing fray damage if it is. Then this effect ends.

profiles.name: DEMOLISHER
profiles.description: The Demolisher is pure strength and rage personified. It can be used to represent particularly colossal warriors, giants, or huge armored beasts.
profiles.traitsText: The Demolisher is pure strength and rage personified. It can be used to represent particularly colossal warriors, giants, or huge armored beasts. Special Traits: Size 2, Sturdy Legend: Takes 1 turn for each player character

abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, this character may clear a status or mark. Phases: Starts in Phase I and enters Phase II when bloodied.

abilities.name: Lumbering Charge
abilities.rulesText: At the end of the round, the Demolisher may Rush 1 up to four times. Before each space of this rush, it shoves all adjacent foes 1 space and deals 1 damage to them. Phase I

abilities.name: Pound
abilities.header: 1 action, true strike, attack, range 2, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray damage. Deals bonus damage for each: character is weakened, slashed, or stunned. •

abilities.name: Battle Roar
abilities.rulesText: Foes in range 2 take 2 piercing damage. Bloodied foes are slashed.

abilities.name: Quake Strike
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 3[D]+fray. Miss or Area effect: [D]+fray. Effect: Create a pit under attack target.

abilities.name: Hurl Boulder
abilities.rulesText: Effect: A foe in range takes 2 damage and is shoved 1, then create a height 1 boulder object next to them.

abilities.name: Lash
abilities.rulesText: The Demolisher whips a chain, hook, or weapon around a foe in range, shoving them 2 spaces towards the Demolisher. Collide: Foe is weakened. Weakened foes take fray damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Vault
abilities.rulesText: The Demolisher removes itself from the battlefield, then places itself in range 3. Characters under it when its placed take 2 damage and are removed and placed in any adjacent space as they are tossed around. Phase II As Phase I but Lumbering Charge triggers twice. Additionally gains the following traits: Frothing Mad: Attacks gain +1 boon and can critically hit (+[D]). Enrage: +1 action

abilities.name: Great Lash
abilities.rulesText: The Demolisher whips a chain or hook around all foes in range. They are shoved 2 spaces towards the demolisher. Collide: Foes are weakened. Weakened foes take fray damage.

profiles.name: NOCTURNAL
profiles.description: The Nocturnal relies on extreme mobility and fear to strike down its foes. It can be used to represent winged demons, master assassins gargoyles, or other vicious and mobile foes.
profiles.traitsText: The Nocturnal relies on extreme mobility and fear to strike down its foes. It can be used to represent winged demons, master assassins gargoyles, or other vicious and mobile foes. Special Traits: Skirmisher Legend: Takes 1 turn for each player character

abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, this character may clear a status or mark. Pick Off: Attacks gain +1 boon against and can critical hit (+[D]) against foes with no allies adjacent. Master of the Night: The Nocturnal has aura 2. It has evasion and gains stealth if there are no other characters in the aura. Phases: Phase change triggers at the start of each round. The Nocturnal starts in phase I and goes up to phase II, then III, then back to I. Actions Has the following actions in all phases:

abilities.name: Crippling Paranoia
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, the Nocturnal chooses a foe. At the end of the round, that foe deals 6 damage to all allies in adjacent spaces and dazes them, then the nocturnal can shove them 1 in any direction.

abilities.name: The Pain
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, range 3, true strike, combo
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Teleport 1. Attack: On hit: [D]+fray and shove 1. Miss: fray damage. Effect: Teleport 1

abilities.name: The Agony
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 3 piercing damage, three times. Miss: 3 piercing damage once. •

abilities.name: The Horror
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss: [D]+fray. Effect: Deals 2 damage again to the target for each that is true: bloodied, blinded, dazed.

abilities.name: Bloody Slash
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes in the area take 2 damage once for every foe in the line, up to three times. The Nocturnal may teleport to any space in the area after this ability resolves.

abilities.name: Great Fell Shot
abilities.rulesText: Choose two free spaces in range. Characters that enter that space or start their turn there are struck by a projectile, taking 3 piercing damage twice, and ending this effect. This area lasts until triggered. Phase I

abilities.name: Lost and Alone
abilities.rulesText: The Nocturnal swaps the places of two foes in range 3 of the Nocturnal and each other, removing and placing them. One foe is then dazed.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.rulesText: The Nocturnal chooses a foe in range 3 that has not acted yet this round. At the end of that foe’s turn, as long as they’re in range 3, teleport to any space adjacent to them, deal 2 damage, three times to them, and blind them. Reduce this damage to just 2 damage if they have an adjacent ally. Then, fly 1. Phase II

abilities.name: Amygdala
abilities.rulesText: All foes in range are inflicted with supernatural fear. They must save or be shoved 3 spaces in a direction of the Nocturnal’s choice, or 1 space on a successful save. Phase III

abilities.name: Bloody Nightmare
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, the Nocturnal supernaturally slashes all foes. For the rest of combat, all foes take 2 piercing damage at the start of their turns. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Kidnap
abilities.rulesText: The Nocturnal dashes 4. A foe adjacent to any point during its dash is removed from the battlefield, then placed adjacent when it finishes its movement. Foes can save to avoid this effect, but are dazed on a successful save.

profiles.name: Master
profiles.description: The Master represents a monster that commands a legion of lesser minions, such as an enormous spider, a warlord, or a relict necromancer.
profiles.traitsText: The Master represents a monster that commands a legion of lesser minions, such as an enormous spider, a warlord, or a relict necromancer. Legend: Takes 1 turn for each player character

abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, this character may clear a status or mark. The Horde: The Master starts combat with a unique Minions mob. Minions can be placed anywhere not in range 2 of a player. The Minions mob is defeated if the Master is defeated.

profiles.name: Minions
profiles.traitsText: Members: 4/player Members: Hits: 2 Speed: 4/2 Defense: 8 Traits: Mob [D]: d6 Fray: 3 This mob takes one turn a round, at the end of the round after all other characters have acted. Phases: The Master starts in Phase I. At the start of round 4, the Master goes into Phase II. Phase I Minion Mob Actions

abilities.name: Press the Assault
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray damage. Effect: Up to four other minions can dash 2. Then, any foes adjacent to at least one minion that dashed this way take 2 piercing damage. The effects of the following can’t be active on the same members:

abilities.name: Guardian Stance
abilities.rulesText: Up to four minions take a defensive stance until the start of the mob’s next turn. For the duration, if the master is targeted by an ability and is adjacent to one of these minions, the minion can sacrifice themself as an interrupt, destroying them, to grant the master resistance to that ability and +1 boon on any saves. The mob can take this interrupt any number of times a round, but only once a turn.

abilities.name: Skewering Wall
abilities.rulesText: Up to four minions take an aggressive stance until the start of the mob’s next turn. For the duration, any foe that starts or ends their turn adjacent to one of these minions takes 2 piercing damage and is shoved 1. Master Actions

abilities.name: Assault Wave
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, the master chooses a burst 2 (target space) area of the battlefield. At the end of the round, foes in the area are charged by all minions in the area. They must save or take 3 piercing damage per minion in the area, up to a maximum of six times, or just 1 piercing damage per minion on a successful save.

abilities.name: Aggressive Tempo
abilities.header: 1 action, true strike, range 2, attack, combo
abilities.rulesText: . On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray damage. Effect: Foe is sealed. The Master and any minions in range 2 may dash 2 before or after this attack.

abilities.name: Defensive Tempo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray damage. Effect: The Master shoves all foes in range 2 one space, then the Master gains counter until the start of its next turn, and grants counter to any adjacent minions for the same duration.

abilities.name: Promote
abilities.rulesText: A minion gains 6 vigor and can immediately use Press the Assault, ignoring the attack limit. Damage that spills over from this vigor deals one ‘hit’ of damage as normal to the minion.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.rulesText: The Master summons a Rally Point object in free space not adjacent to a foe in range 3. If using this action again with an active rally point, it moves the rally point rather than summoning a new one.

profiles.name: Rally Point
profiles.traitsText: Size 1 object, destructible (10 hp) Object effect: Aura 1. Minions in the aura are immune to all damage and Press the Assault against characters in the area deals maximum damage.

abilities.name: Disabling Strike
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range 3 is pacified, then shoved 1 in any direction. Pacified foes are shoved 3 instead.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes take 2 piercing damage. Allies are immune.

profiles.name: Razer
profiles.description: A powerful and destructive being, such as a flying wyrm, an arch-wright, or an ancient demon.
profiles.traitsText: A powerful and destructive being, such as a flying wyrm, an arch-wright, or an ancient demon. Legend: Takes 1 turn for each player character

abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, this character may clear a status or mark. Phases: Starts in Phase I, then moves up a phase at the start of each around, looping back to Phase I after III. Phase I

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, create 2 rock spires, height 1 objects, in free space within range 2 of a foe. Foes adjacent when the spires are created take 2 piercing damage.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, choose a character in range 6. At the end of that character’s turn, the Razer shoots an energy blast at them for a medium blast explosion area effect. Characters within must save. On a successful save, they take piercing fray damage. On a failed save they take [D]+fray piercing damage. Rock spires in the area are destroyed.

abilities.name: Raze
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Attack target is vulnerable. Effect: Vulnerable foes release a burst 1 explosion centered on them, dealing 2 damage to all foes within.

abilities.name: Resonant Blast
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, range 6, pierce, medium blast
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Deal fray damage again to all foes for every object or pit caught in the area.

abilities.name: Swat
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range is shoved 2. Collide: Foe is shattered.

abilities.name: Aether Split
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: 2 damage, Effect: teleport all characters in the area 1. Teleport self 3 instead if in the area.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.rulesText: A Rock spire in range erupts. Adjacent characters take 2 damage, then the spire creates 3 spaces of difficult terrain in adjacent spaces. Phase II As Phase I, but:

abilities.name: Orbital Strike
abilities.rulesText: Choose a space in range 5. At the end of the round, the Razer removes itself from the battlefield and lands in the space, placing itself. Foes in a large blast area centered on them take [D]+fray damage as an area effect and have a pit created under them.

abilities.name: Soar
abilities.rulesText: Fly 3 Phase III As Phase I, but : Radiance: When this phase triggers, remove the Razer from the battlefield, then place them in the center of the battlefield, or as close as possible. The Razer is immobile during this phase but its abilities have no maximum range. All characters not in cover from the Razer take 4 piercing damage at the end of their turn.

abilities.name: Elden Chaos
abilities.rulesText: At the end of the round, the Razer fires a blast of pure ancient chaos. The blast is a large blast area effect centered on any space in line of sight from the Razer. Foes in the area must save. On a failed save, they take 2[D]+fray piercing damage, twice. On a successful save, they take piercing fray damage, twice . Characters in cover automatically succeed the save. Then destroy all rock spires.

profiles.name: Temple Monk
profiles.description: A priest of the chambers. Their knowledge of titan lore is extensive and they are capable of channeling divine power through their voice alone.
profiles.traitsText: A priest of the chambers. Their knowledge of titan lore is extensive and they are capable of channeling divine power through their voice alone. Unique traits: Defiance

abilities.name: Peal of Reckoning
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Target must save or be shoved 1 three times, or shoved 1 on a successful save. Each shove can be in a different direction. Charge: Range 6

abilities.name: Forbiddance
abilities.rulesText: The temple monk chooses a foe in range. That foe is sealed and until the end of their next turn, takes 2 damage after entering any space that moves them closer to the Temple Monk without being shoved.

abilities.name: Prayer
abilities.rulesText: The temple monk ends their turn and gains Delay: Their next turn must be slow. At the start of that turn, this character and all adjacent allies are cured.

profiles.name: Bell Warden
profiles.description: Muscle-corded temple priests that are the ringers and guardians of the mighty bells of the Chambers, whose peal drives away evil creatures such as demons. These bells, though numerous, are holy objects, and their care and upkeep is a duty of the highest order.
profiles.traitsText: Muscle-corded temple priests that are the ringers and guardians of the mighty bells of the Chambers, whose peal drives away evil creatures such as demons. These bells, though numerous, are holy objects, and their care and upkeep is a duty of the highest order.

abilities.name: Fist of Fury
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] + fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Attack target is weakened. Charge: Deal 2 damage to all adjacent foes.

abilities.name: Roundhouse kick
abilities.rulesText: The Bell Warden rushes 1, then adjacent character is shoved 1 in any direction, including diagonally.

abilities.name: Temple Bell
abilities.rulesText: The Bell Warden ends their turn and gains Delay: Their next turn must be slow. At the start of that turn, summon a temple bell in a free adjacent space. Temple Bell Size 1 object Object effect: When summoned, or when a character collides with it, releases a massive ringing. All characters in range 2 except the Bellkeeper must save or become weakened. Weakened characters take fray damage twice instead of saving. This effect can’t trigger more than once a round. Multiple bells can be summoned at once.

profiles.name: Yaman
profiles.description: Warrior-nuns and monks that live on the mountains, training in martial arts and strengthening their bodies through rigorous diet and exercise. They tend to be more than a little eccentric.
profiles.traitsText: Warrior-nuns and monks that live on the mountains, training in martial arts and strengthening their bodies through rigorous diet and exercise. They tend to be more than a little eccentric.

abilities.name: Axe Kick
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage to bloodied foes. Charge: Gains range 2 and may dash 2 before using this ability.

abilities.name: Roppo
abilities.rulesText: The Yaman takes a pose and gains the following interrupt until the start of their next turn. Roppo Interrupt 2 Trigger: A foe uses an ability in range 2, and the ability resolves Effect: The Yaman may dash 2, then deal 2 damage to an adjacent foe.

abilities.name: Hurl Boulder
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range takes 2 damage, is dazed, and is shoved 1.

abilities.name: Izuna Drop
abilities.rulesText: The Yaman takes a pose, then ends their turn and gains Delay: Their next turn must be slow. At the start of that turn, they may dash 2. Then, if a foe is adjacent the Yaman grabs them, removing both of them from the battlefield, then placing both of them back in free space adjacent to each other in range 2. The foe must save. On a successful save, they take fray damage and are dazed. On a failed save, they are stunned and take 2[D]+fray.

profiles.name: Inquisitor
profiles.description: Lightning-wielding relic hunters of the Chroniclers, who are sent out in search of dangerous artifacts to recover and imprison in the Chambers.
profiles.traitsText: Lightning-wielding relic hunters of the Chroniclers, who are sent out in search of dangerous artifacts to recover and imprison in the Chambers.

abilities.name: Lightning Spear
abilities.rulesText: On hi: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Attack target is vulnerable. Charge: Deal 2 piercing damage again to target and to all foes in range 3 of the target

abilities.name: Reliquary
abilities.rulesText: The inquisitor marks a foe in range. While marked, all damage against the foe gains pierce, and that foe takes 1 piercing damage again after being hit or missed by any attack.

abilities.name: Expurgation
abilities.rulesText: The Inquisitor ends their turn, chooses a large blast area in range 6, and gains Delay: Their next turn must be slow. At the start of that turn, that area erupts with lightning. Area effect: Characters inside must save or take piercing fray damage, once, for every character in the area, or just once on a successful save.

profiles.name: Doorkicker
profiles.description: Relic thieves and scouts who specialize in breaking doors, locks, and mechanisms to get prospective adventurers deeper into dungeons.
profiles.traitsText: Relic thieves and scouts who specialize in breaking doors, locks, and mechanisms to get prospective adventurers deeper into dungeons.

abilities.name: Knee in the back
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray, Miss: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage if made from stealth.

abilities.name: Blackjack
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe is dazed. If made from stealth, this action also deals fray damage.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.rulesText: Dash 1 and gain stealth

abilities.name: Wild Gamble
abilities.rulesText: Roll 1d6. Dash exactly that many spaces in a straight line, or as far as possible, then deal damage equal to the spaces moved to an adjacent foe. If no foes are adjacent, deal no damage.

profiles.name: Deep Farmer
profiles.description: Dour Churners who make a living out of growing various rare and exotic dungeon flora - which unfortunately only grow in the warped aether of dungeons. This requires a great deal of caution, bravery, and expertise.
profiles.traitsText: Dour Churners who make a living out of growing various rare and exotic dungeon flora - which unfortunately only grow in the warped aether of dungeons. This requires a great deal of caution, bravery, and expertise.

abilities.name: Raze
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: All foes in range 2 take 2 damage.

abilities.name: Swing Shovel
abilities.rulesText: Rush 1, then Roll 1d6. An adjacent character takes that much damage, and is shoved half that number of spaces. Collide: Foe is stunned.

abilities.name: Fertilize
abilities.rulesText: The Deep Farmer chooses a space in range. At the end of their turn, this space grows into a mushroom object. Mushroom Size 1 object Object effect: Aura 1. Characters in the spore-filled aura other than the Deep Farmer choke and are weakened.

abilities.name: Pull Vegetable
abilities.rulesText: The Deep farmer pulls out a massive vegetable by the roots. Its next attack deals bonus damage and stuns on hit. Stunned foes are critically hit (+[D]) on hit.

profiles.name: Guide
profiles.description: Savvy and seasoned dungeon explorers with the wits not to get into the adventuring business Tend to go the other way when the action starts.
profiles.traitsText: Savvy and seasoned dungeon explorers with the wits not to get into the adventuring business Tend to go the other way when the action starts. Aura of Freedom: Aura 1. The Guide and allies in the aura are immune to movement penalties from terrain and elevation.

abilities.name: Tranquilize
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: fray damage and foe is pacified. Pacified foes take [D]+fray instead.

abilities.name: Grappling hook
abilities.rulesText: The Guide teleports adjacent to a summon or object in range. Alternately, it can teleport adjacent to a foe in range, then shove that foe 1.

abilities.name: Double Time
abilities.rulesText: Roll 1d6. The Guide chooses a number of allies equal to half that number, then shoves them a number of spaces equal to that number in any direction.

profiles.name: Shopkeep
profiles.description: The most noble of Churner professions, and the most common. Though sometimes derided as price-gouging opportunists, a lot of shopkeepers come from old and honorable families and recognize the necessity of preparation for a dungeon trip as an essential part of safe expeditions, making sure their prices are fair, and their shops well-stocked.
profiles.traitsText: The most noble of Churner professions, and the most common. Though sometimes derided as price-gouging opportunists, a lot of shopkeepers come from old and honorable families and recognize the necessity of preparation for a dungeon trip as an essential part of safe expeditions, making sure their prices are fair, and their shops well-stocked.

abilities.name: Ban from the shop
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: fray damage. Foe is marked. While marked, if they end their turn in the shop’s aura, they take [D]+fray piercing damage.

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.rulesText: Effect: A character in range takes 1 piercing damage. If that character attacks before the end of their next turn, they take [D]+fray piercing damage and this effect ends.

abilities.name: Open Shop
abilities.rulesText: The Shopkeep opens their shop, a size 1 object, summoning it in an adjacent space. It lasts until the shopkeep is defeated or this ability is used again. Shop Size 1 object, immobile Object Effect: No fighting in the shop. Aura 1. Characters in the area other than the shopkeep are pacified+. Object Effect: While the shop is active, any character in the aura can use the Rummage action, which ignores pacified.

abilities.name: Rummage
abilities.rulesText: The character rummages in the shop and throws something at a character in range 3. Roll 1d6. 1. 10 foot pole: Character takes 2 damage and is shoved 2 2. Lantern: character takes 4 damage and loses stealth. 3. Ration: character takes 1 damage. Place the ration in a free adjacent space. A character can eat it by entering its space and using 1 action to gain 5 vigor 4. Bomb: Area effect: medium blast, deals [D]+fray damage 5. Strange mushroom: character takes fray damage and becomes sealed. 6. Choose two

profiles.name: Guilder
profiles.description: Though the cities of Arden Eld are few, they are growing in both size and influence. With no real counties or kingdoms, they are the closest thing to nations across the great Green. Their citizens tend to be proud, loyal, and hardworking, even if a little packed in. Though diverse in both rule and character, the cities are largely dominated by the great Trade Guilds and their fleets of airships, and the Colleges with their trained Wrights, machines, and clockwork. The highlords of the guilds and colleges are powerful indeed, and pursue their own agendas and machinations with great vigor. Though many are high minded and truly believe in ideas of progress, equality, and wealth for all, others are more cynical, worldly, or greedy, and are not above employing ruthless tactics to accomplish their goals.

abilities.name: GREAT CULTURE: Strive
abilities.rulesText: Until the start of their next turn, the Guider increases the distance of any dash, rush, teleport or flight by +3. Uniques

profiles.name: Guard
profiles.traitsText: City militia and watchmen, sometimes on the payrolls of the Great Guilds. Hold the Line: If the Guard ends any turn without attacking, they gain Sturdy and Vigilance +1.

abilities.name: Mace
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+Fray. Miss: fray.

abilities.name: Shield Charge
abilities.rulesText: The Guard rushes 1, then adjacent foe is shoved 1. Collide: Foe is weakened.

abilities.name: Get Down!
abilities.rulesText: The Guard gains the following interrupt until the end of their next turn. If the interrupt goes unused until then, they may rush 2. Get Down Interrupt 1 Trigger: An ally takes damage that would reduce them to 0 hp. Effect: The Guard can rush 3. If that puts them adjacent to their ally, that ally goes to 1 hp instead, and the guard sacrifices 25% of their hp.

abilities.name: On the Spot
abilities.rulesText: The Guard chooses a space in range, which could be under themselves. While standing on the spot, the Guard has resistance. This effect lasts until this ability is used again.

profiles.name: Sky Knight
profiles.traitsText: Knights from the great guild academies. Renowned explorers and merchants that swear oaths of valor on their swords, the sky knights serve the colleges and will throw their lives down in service of progress, science, and protection.

abilities.name: Oath Sword
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage and slashes on hit if the knight is bloodied.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe is slashed. Slashed foes take fray damage.

abilities.name: Stinger
abilities.rulesText: The Sky knight rushes 2 spaces in a straight line, then deals 3 damage, twice, to an adjacent foe. This action can only be taken if there are no foes adjacent.

abilities.name: Great Stride
abilities.rulesText: The Sky Knight rushes up to 6 spaces in a straight line, phasing through characters. Foes they pass through take 2 damage, and are then shoved 1 to either side, and the knight gains 2 vigor per foe passed through.

profiles.name: Aeronaut
profiles.description: Elite crew of the airships and dwellers of the teetering city spires of Arden Eld’s great cities. Aeronauts use aether powered gear to soar, dive, and spin in midair during work and combat.
profiles.traitsText: Elite crew of the airships and dwellers of the teetering city spires of Arden Eld’s great cities. Aeronauts use aether powered gear to soar, dive, and spin in midair during work and combat. Aerial Acrobat: If an attack misses the Aeronaut, they may deal 2 damage to the attacker, then fly 2.

abilities.name: Strafe shot
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Dash 1 On hit: [D] +fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Dash 1

abilities.name: Double tap
abilities.rulesText: The Aeronaut flies 3 spaces in a straight line. At the start and end of their movement, they may deal 2 damage to a character in range 3, choosing different characters each time.

abilities.name: Blinding grenade
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range 3 is blinded. Blinded foes take 3 damage.

abilities.name: Takeoff
abilities.rulesText: The Aeronaut launches into the air. While in this stance, they are flying and have evasion. They lose this stance if they are hit by an attack.

profiles.name: Aerothurge
profiles.description: Highly skilled wrights that are navigators of the airships. Airships fly not on air, but on currents of Aether, so only someone highly skilled and with a great degree of sensitivity can guide them safely around its surges and storms.
profiles.traitsText: Highly skilled wrights that are navigators of the airships. Airships fly not on air, but on currents of Aether, so only someone highly skilled and with a great degree of sensitivity can guide them safely around its surges and storms.

abilities.name: High Pressure
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, range 6, large blast, pierce
abilities.rulesText: On hit: fray damage, four times. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Can target one end of a portal. If so, the attack travels through the portal and is then retargeted to a new space or character within range 3 of the other end of the portal, as if by rebound.

abilities.name: Whisk
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range becomes vulnerable, then is teleported 1. Vulnerable foes are teleported 3 instead.

abilities.name: Aether Portal
abilities.rulesText: The Aerothurge chooses any two free spaces on the battlefield and links them with glowing portals. Portal Size 1 object Object effect: Any character adjacent to a portal can spend 2 spaces of movement to teleport adjacent to the other linked portal, or vice versa.

profiles.name: Islander
profiles.description: Brave, hardy, and adventurous folk, the islanders are not ones to shy away from trouble. Every one of the Thousand Isles is a stunningly diverse place - from it’s people, to its food, to its sights and sounds, to its dangers. All islands dabble in a little light piracy here and there, mostly from the soft and cargo-laden ships of the great guilds, and pirates and freelance brigadiers are often viewed as local heroes. In times of trouble or scarcity, particularly hardened or unscrupulous Jarls may order raids on coastal villages. These can often turn into bloody affairs, and the Jarls into warlords.

abilities.name: GREAT CULTURE: Bravado
abilities.rulesText: This character sacrifices 50% of their max hp but immediately gains +1 action. Uniques

profiles.name: Cook
profiles.description: All self respecting islanders know how to eat and cook properly. Cooks hold an extremely high position in Islander culture, the highest of which sit next to Jarls, the rulers of the great islands.
profiles.traitsText: All self respecting islanders know how to eat and cook properly. Cooks hold an extremely high position in Islander culture, the highest of which sit next to Jarls, the rulers of the great islands.

abilities.name: Hot Griddle
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is sealed. Effect: Critical hit (+[D]) against sealed foes.

abilities.name: Flapjack
abilities.rulesText: The cook summons a flapjack in range. Flapjack Size 1 summon, intangible Summon Effect: A character other than the cook moving into the flapjack’s space can pick it up, removing it. That character gains defiance. A character that already has defiance gains 6 vigor. A character with vigor becomes unstoppable until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Cook up a storm
abilities.rulesText: The Cook creates a burst 2 (self) terrain effect until the start of their next turn. Foes in the area are shoved until outside the of area when it is created. The area is dangerous terrain for foes, provides cover for allies, and allies in the area when it is created gain 3 vigor.

profiles.name: Sailor
profiles.description: The great mass of sailors, pirates, raiders, crewmen, and pilots of the great islander fleets. The greatest sailors of the Thousand Isles are legendary in skill and have many a perilous voyage under their belt.
profiles.traitsText: The great mass of sailors, pirates, raiders, crewmen, and pilots of the great islander fleets. The greatest sailors of the Thousand Isles are legendary in skill and have many a perilous voyage under their belt. Salty: When the Sailor sacrifices any amount, they gain 3 vigor after the triggering ability resolves.

abilities.name: Bloody crescent
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray

abilities.name: Sea Legs
abilities.rulesText: Shove all adjacent characters 1 space in the same direction. C ollide: foes are slashed.

abilities.name: Plunder
abilities.rulesText: The Sailor dashes 1, then deals 2 damage and shoves an adjacent foe 1,

abilities.name: Send to Erenhelion
abilities.rulesText: The Sailor winds up for a massive blow. An adjacent foe must save or take 3[D]+fray and become slashed, or just [D]+fray on a successful save. Effect: The Sailor sacrifices 25% of their maximum hp after this ability resolves.

profiles.name: Doom Diver
profiles.description: Donning capes of serpent scales or sealskin, the doom divers make sport of diving for treasures, food, and pearls in monster-infested waters.
profiles.traitsText: Donning capes of serpent scales or sealskin, the doom divers make sport of diving for treasures, food, and pearls in monster-infested waters. Nimble: Has evasion unless suffering from a status

abilities.name: Spear Slash
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage to and gains unerring against foes at exactly range 3.

abilities.name: Slide
abilities.rulesText: The Diver dashes 3 with phasing, dealing 2 damage to all characters it passes through

abilities.name: Dive
abilities.rulesText: The Diver chooses a foe in range, then removes themselves from the battlefield. At the end of that foe’s next turn, that foe must save as the Diver descends, dealing [D]+fray three times on a failed save, or just once on a successful save. Lower this damage by [D]+fray for every adjacent ally of the target, which could cause it to do no damage. Then, place the Diver in any free space in range 2.

profiles.name: Harpooner
profiles.description: Sturdy hunters that sail out in search of the megafish and sea monsters that populate the deep oceans of Arden Eld. Their catch feeds the atolls, but requires entire teams to haul ashore.
profiles.traitsText: Sturdy hunters that sail out in search of the megafish and sea monsters that populate the deep oceans of Arden Eld. Their catch feeds the atolls, but requires entire teams to haul ashore.

abilities.name: Spear
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray. Miss or Area Effect: fray. Effect: If attacking an adjacent foe, deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Backflip
abilities.rulesText: The Harpooner dashes 1. If there is an adjacent foe, increase this dash to 2, and shove that foe 1.

abilities.name: Net
abilities.rulesText: The Harpooner creates a net terrain effect in a free space range. The net space is treated as a pit and difficult terrain.

abilities.name: Main Harpoon
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range must save or take 2[D]+fray, become shattered, and be shoved towards the Harpooner until adjacent. On a success, the foe takes fray and is shoved 1 towards the harpooner instead.

profiles.name: Leggio
profiles.description: Part warrior clan, part merchant enclave, and part theatre troupe, a Leggio caravan is a magnificent (and relieving) sight to all across the Green. The Leggio caravans are the lifeblood of Arden Eld, for without them, far off towns and settlements isolated by dungeons and growing blights would be starved of supplies, medicine, and food. Their arrival in a town is part circus, part festival, and part market day. The caravans occasionally accept shady business, sometimes out of profit, sometimes out of desperation - transporting dangerous, rare, or illicit goods. Rarely, and usually due to some traumatic event, a wagon abandons the ways and strictures of the Multicolored Titan, and turns to banditry and thievery. These rogue wagons abandon the caravan and become similar to pirates - though they sail the seas of grass and stone instead of water.
