abilities.name: Acrobatics
abilities.rulesText: Dash 2. This action can interrupt and split up other actions or movement. Uniques

profiles.name: Storyteller
profiles.description: Elders of the Caravans, who keep and carve the lore and lineage of the families that make it up into the side of the wagons.
profiles.traitsText: Elders of the Caravans, who keep and carve the lore and lineage of the families that make it up into the side of the wagons.

abilities.name: Story Staff
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: fray damage and foe is pacified. Pacified foes instead take [D]+fray.

abilities.name: Felicity
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range is marked. When marked, and at the start of the storyteller’s turn, the marked ally may dash 1.

abilities.name: Fleet
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range 4 may fly 4

abilities.name: Heroism
abilities.rulesText: The Storyteller gains aura 2. Allies in the aura gain +1 boon on all saves and may save against statuses at the start instead of end of their turn.

profiles.name: Monster Rider
profiles.description: Braves of a family, usually young, who tame the massive beasts the Leggio must battle with during their journeys through the blights. Monster taming is a time-honored tradition and without it, many of the great wagons would lack a way to move, as most normal animals don’t have to the strength to pull them.
profiles.traitsText: Braves of a family, usually young, who tame the massive beasts the Leggio must battle with during their journeys through the blights. Monster taming is a time-honored tradition and without it, many of the great wagons would lack a way to move, as most normal animals don’t have to the strength to pull them. Monster Riding: The Rider starts combat riding a trained monster, and can also mount it as an action or by spending its standard move. While riding, the rider shares space with the monster and moves when it moves, becoming unstoppable while moving this way. If the two are separated, this effect ends until the monster is remounted.

profiles.name: Tame monster
profiles.traitsText: Summon, size 1 Summon Action: During the rider’s turn, can dash 4, then either shove a character 1 space or deal 2 damage to them.

abilities.name: Double Team
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]. Miss: 1 damage. Effect: The rider and an ally in range 3 can each dash 1, then deal 2 damage to an adjacent foe.

abilities.name: Call out
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range 3 must save or be shoved towards the rider as far as possible, then gain hatred of the rider. On a successful save, they are shoved 1 towards the rider.

abilities.name: Lancer’s Splendor
abilities.rulesText: The rider takes a magnificent pose and gains aura 1. The rider and allies in the aura are sturdy and deal bonus damage with all abilities.

profiles.name: Acrobat
profiles.description: Workers who maintain the caravans while they are on the move, requiring great dexterity and agility. In town, they often perform.
profiles.traitsText: Workers who maintain the caravans while they are on the move, requiring great dexterity and agility. In town, they often perform. Tumbling: Moving up terrain costs no movement. Can phase through characters and doing so costs a maximum of 1 movement.

abilities.name: Spinning kick
abilities.rulesText: Repeat the following effect three times: Dash 1, then deal 2 damage to all adjacent foes. Must move in the same direction.

abilities.name: Cartwheel
abilities.rulesText: The Acrobat dashes up to 3 spaces, then deals damage to an adjacent foe equal to the number of spaces it dashed.

abilities.name: Partner Work
abilities.rulesText: The Acrobat marks an ally. That ally gains evasion and +1 boon on attacks while in range 3 of the Acrobat.

abilities.name: Acrobatics
abilities.rulesText: The acrobat takes a nimble stance. While in this stance, they gain evasion, and when targeted by an ability, may dash 1 after the ability resolves.

profiles.name: Pole Fighter
profiles.description: The militia of the caravans, who use long poles to vault from wagon to wagon.
profiles.traitsText: The militia of the caravans, who use long poles to vault from wagon to wagon. Slam: When a character collides from the pole fighter’s moves, they are slashed. Slashed characters take fray damage instead.

abilities.name: Pole Slam
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: shove all characters 1.

abilities.name: Rebound
abilities.rulesText: The Pole Fighter pushes off an adjacent character. They shove that character 1 space, then rush 1. Collide: If their target collides with an ally, that ally may also rush 1

abilities.name: High Flyer
abilities.rulesText: The Pole Fighter balances on their pole and uses it to move, ignoring all terrain damage and movement penalties, rampart, and engagement while in this stance.

abilities.name: Dive kick
abilities.rulesText: The Pole fighter rushes 1, ending their High Flyer stance. An adjacent foe is stunned and must save or take 2[D]+fray, or just [D]+fray on a successful save.

profiles.name: Fire Dancer
profiles.description: Fire wrights who light and keep the lanterns burning all day and night. The task is odious, the monster oil used to fuel the lanterns noxious and stinking, so when they enter a town they are happy to let loose with pyrotechnic juggling shows.
profiles.traitsText: Fire wrights who light and keep the lanterns burning all day and night. The task is odious, the monster oil used to fuel the lanterns noxious and stinking, so when they enter a town they are happy to let loose with pyrotechnic juggling shows.

abilities.name: Flame Dance
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Dash 1, then deal piercing fray damage to a different character in range 6.

abilities.name: Carnivale
abilities.rulesText: The Fire dancer summons a bomb in range 4. Bomb Summon Summon Effect: When any character enters its space, it explodes for a small blast area effect explosion. Characters within become vulnerable, then must save or take 2 piercing damage twice, or just 2 piercing damage on a successful save.

abilities.name: Juggle
abilities.rulesText: The fire dancer starts juggling flames. While in this stance, at the start and end of their turn, they may dash 2, then deal 2 piercing damage as an area effect to all foes in range 3.

profiles.name: Villager
profiles.description: The common clay of Arden Eld.
profiles.traitsText: The common clay of Arden Eld.

abilities.name: Valorous Strike
abilities.rulesText: Autohit: fray damage. Effect: An ally in range 3 of a villager gains 2 vigor, or 4 vigor if bloodied. Effect: May dash 1 before the attack.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.rulesText: Effect: Up to three allies adjacent to a villager may dash 1 space, or one ally adjacent to a villager may dash 3 spaces.

abilities.name: Take heart
abilities.rulesText: All allies adjacent to a villager may end a status and gain 2 vigor, or 4 vigor if they are bloodied.

profiles.name: Farmer
profiles.description: A thick-armed commoner, sometimes acting as a local militia in times of trouble.
profiles.traitsText: A thick-armed commoner, sometimes acting as a local militia in times of trouble.

abilities.name: Righteous fist
abilities.rulesText: On hit [D]+fray and shove 2. Miss: fray and shove 1. Effect: Deals bonus damage to weakened foes. Collide: Foe is weakened.

abilities.name: Community Watch
abilities.rulesText: Shove all allies in range 2 1 space towards this character, then any adjacent allies gain 2 vigor.

abilities.name: Bale
abilities.rulesText: The Farmer uses a pitchfork, shovel, or sheer strength and picks up an adjacent character size 1 or smaller, removing them from the battlefield and placing them in an adjacent space, then shoving them 1. Weakened foes are shoved 3 instead.

abilities.name: On the Chin
abilities.rulesText: The Farmer gains aura 1. The farmer and allies in the aura are sturdy, and gain 3 vigor at the start of the farmer’s turn.

profiles.name: Barkeep
profiles.description: The taverns, inns, and way-houses of the villages are a relatively new invention as commerce returns to Arden Eld, but a welcome one. Their owners are typically stocky and no-nonsense.
profiles.traitsText: The taverns, inns, and way-houses of the villages are a relatively new invention as commerce returns to Arden Eld, but a welcome one. Their owners are typically stocky and no-nonsense.

abilities.name: Flaming Cocktail
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, range 6, small blast, pierce
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Round 3+: Large blast

abilities.name: Bar Brawler
abilities.rulesText: The Barkeep takes a fighting stance, with the following benefits: • They gain counter and sturdy. • Any time a foe ends their turn adjacent to the barkeep in this stance, they take 2 piercing damage and are shoved 1. • If a foe collides with the Barkeep, they take 2 piercing damage and are shoved 1, but only once a round.

abilities.name: Barrel Roll
abilities.header: 1 action, range 5, end turn, small blast
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: 2 damage, and shove 2 away from the origin point. At round 3+, becomes a large blast and any character in the center space must save or become stunned.

profiles.name: Village Priest
profiles.description: Village priests of the local temples, who typically pay homage or worship to the local hobs or spirits of nature. These temples are closely tied to the land and may be built around a great tree, or a holy rock, or a sparkling waterfall.
profiles.traitsText: Village priests of the local temples, who typically pay homage or worship to the local hobs or spirits of nature. These temples are closely tied to the land and may be built around a great tree, or a holy rock, or a sparkling waterfall.

abilities.name: Greenwrath
abilities.rulesText: Attack: On hit [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage and inflicts sealed if a character is inside dangerous or difficult terrain.

abilities.name: Sow
abilities.rulesText: The village priest marks a foe in range. That foe takes 1 piercing damage when marked.

abilities.name: Reap
abilities.rulesText: All foes marked by Sow take 3 piercing damage once for every foe marked by Sow.

abilities.name: Sanctify
abilities.rulesText: Terrain effect: The village priest scatters salt in a medium blast area in range. Foes that end their turn in the area become pacified. Allies that end their turn in the area gain 2 vigor. This area ends if this ability is used again.

profiles.name: Shinobi
profiles.description: Nearly all villages in the Green practic e martial arts for self defense against roving monsters (and, more recently, bandits). Many of them have secret scroll arts, some of which have produced secret warrior societies that predate the Shades.
profiles.traitsText: Nearly all villages in the Green practic e martial arts for self defense against roving monsters (and, more recently, bandits). Many of them have secret scroll arts, some of which have produced secret warrior societies that predate the Shades.

abilities.name: Whirling Blade
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: All foes at exactly range 3 take 2 damage, including the attack target.

abilities.name: Shadow clone
abilities.rulesText: Summon a shadow clone in a free space in range. Shadow Clone Summon, size 1 Summon Effect: Foes adjacent to a shadow clone at the start of their turn take 3 damage from the clone. The Shinobi and any of its allies may gain stealth if they end their turn adjacent to a clone. Clones disappear at the end of combat or if the Shinobi is defeated.

abilities.name: Shadow Swap
abilities.rulesText: The Shinobi or an ally swaps places with a shadow clone in range 3 of them, teleporting.

abilities.name: Raiton
abilities.rulesText: The Shinobi calls down lightning on a foe in range. At the end of that foe’s turn, they take 4 damage, five times and are blinded, then this effect ends. Reduce this damage by one time for every other adjacent character to the target, which could cause it to do no damage.

profiles.name: Husk
profiles.description: The shuffling mass of relict servitors, in thrall to the network.
profiles.traitsText: The shuffling mass of relict servitors, in thrall to the network. This mob is always present in Relict fights. When new husks are summoned, they add to the current mob, or create a new one that can act on the following round if there isn’t one. Speed: 2 (dash 1) Endless Dead: Add to this mob by 1 at the start of every round, placing a new member anywhere on the battlefield not adjacent to a foe. Fading: This mob is defeated if all of its allies is defeated, and disintegrates.

abilities.name: Soul Frenzy
abilities.rulesText: Effect: All husks may rush 1 space. Then foes adjacent to one or more husks take 2 piercing damage.

abilities.name: Soul Sacrifice
abilities.rulesText: Choose a bloodied character adjacent to one or more husks, then destroy all husks adjacent to that character. If that character is an ally, they gain 2 vigor per husk destroyed. If that character was a foe, they must sacrifice 2 per husk destroyed.

profiles.name: WIGHT
profiles.description: The foot soldiers of the Arken empire, their loyalty is no lesser in death. Their long imprisonment in the soul network has left them mindless, ruthless killing machines. In the later days of the doom, even before the Ur-spell, many soldiers and guards of high officials, satraps, and priests were subject to the immortalization process, as the population gradually became more used to the undead.
profiles.traitsText: The foot soldiers of the Arken empire, their loyalty is no lesser in death. Their long imprisonment in the soul network has left them mindless, ruthless killing machines. In the later days of the doom, even before the Ur-spell, many soldiers and guards of high officials, satraps, and priests were subject to the immortalization process, as the population gradually became more used to the undead.

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: All foes adjacent to the attack target take fray damage

abilities.name: Hook Spear
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range 2 is shoved 1 towards the Wight and slashed.

abilities.name: Grave Guard
abilities.rulesText: All allies in range may rush 1 towards this character. Bloodied allies that rushed this way gain 3 vigor.

abilities.name: Death March
abilities.rulesText: The Wight and all allies in range may rush 1 space in the same direction, then all foes adjacent to any character that moved this way take 2 damage. Chapter 1+

profiles.name: Tomb Guard
profiles.description: Undead auxiliaries of the old legions, their shields and khopesh a common sight in the catacombs.
profiles.traitsText: Undead auxiliaries of the old legions, their shields and khopesh a common sight in the catacombs.

abilities.name: Fortress
abilities.rulesText: The Tomb Guard gains aura 1 until the start of its next turn. While this aura is active, the Tomb Guard gains counter, and allies without this ability in the aura gain resistance.

profiles.name: Servitor
profiles.description: Guards of the priest class, with wicked spears for tearing flesh and forcing obedience.
profiles.traitsText: Guards of the priest class, with wicked spears for tearing flesh and forcing obedience.

abilities.name: Impaling Jab
abilities.rulesText: Effect: The Servitor may rush 1 before using this ability. Area effect: characters take 2 damage. Any character at the very end of the line is weakened.

profiles.name: Executioner
profiles.description: Wielding heavy curved axes, these shock troops fight with little regard for their own existence.
profiles.traitsText: Wielding heavy curved axes, these shock troops fight with little regard for their own existence.

abilities.name: Lightning Axe
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, range 2, medium blast, true strike, usable when bloodied
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray and shove 2. Miss: or area effect: [D]+fray and shove 1. Collide: Foe is weakened. Chapter 2 Death March becomes a free action if the Wight is bloodied.

profiles.name: Heliolite
profiles.description: Skirmishers from the old legions, they fight with wicked, barbed spears and a canny malice
profiles.traitsText: Skirmishers from the old legions, they fight with wicked, barbed spears and a canny malice

abilities.name: Redondo
abilities.rulesText: Swap places with an adjacent ally, removing and placing both characters.

abilities.name: Replace Overpower with Seeking Javelin
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is slashed. Effect: Has no maximum range and ignores cover against slashed foes. Chapter 3 Death March deals fray damage instead.

profiles.name: Legionary
profiles.description: With interlocking shield, shortspear, and heavy helms, these soldiers made up the bulk of the arkenlords’ armies when they were still alive, trampling empires into dust.
profiles.traitsText: With interlocking shield, shortspear, and heavy helms, these soldiers made up the bulk of the arkenlords’ armies when they were still alive, trampling empires into dust. Traits: Sturdy Legion’s Advance: Death March affects all allies in range 3.

abilities.name: Carve a Path
abilities.rulesText: Repeat the following effect three times: either the Legionary or an adjacent ally rushes 1, then deals 2 damage to all adjacent foes and shoves them 1. This can affect the same foe more than once.

profiles.name: NECROSAVANT
profiles.description: The Priests of the Black Sun were the central cult of the Arken Imperium and foremost in political power and influence. It was they, under the leadership of their sorcerer-priests, that orchestrated the Ur-spell that necrotized what remained of the empire. The process of preserving the entire population of the empire required a great deal of work, and therefore the priests classes were split into many castes that labored at numerous terrible projects. In the end of days, in their desperation, they delved into deeper and darker magics and sacrificed their very souls for the purpose of the Great Work.
profiles.traitsText: The Priests of the Black Sun were the central cult of the Arken Imperium and foremost in political power and influence. It was they, under the leadership of their sorcerer-priests, that orchestrated the Ur-spell that necrotized what remained of the empire. The process of preserving the entire population of the empire required a great deal of work, and therefore the priests classes were split into many castes that labored at numerous terrible projects. In the end of days, in their desperation, they delved into deeper and darker magics and sacrificed their very souls for the purpose of the Great Work. Special Traits: Defiance

abilities.name: Unholy
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Sealed foes must sacrifice 4. Then, attack target is sealed.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.rulesText: Mark a foe in range 6. While marked, that foe deals half damage unless adjacent to an ally. If they end their turn adjacent to an ally, they can save to clear this mark.

abilities.name: Black Communion
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes take 2 damage. Allies gain 2 vigor. Then, create a difficult terrain effect space of grasping dead hands underneath every foe in the area. While inside a grasping hands space, foes are sealed+ and cannot gain vigor. Chapter 1+

profiles.name: Arkivist
profiles.description: Priests entrusted with keeping the names of the dead, they wander the halls of the arkenruins obsessively repeating the names of their wards.
profiles.traitsText: Priests entrusted with keeping the names of the dead, they wander the halls of the arkenruins obsessively repeating the names of their wards. Shepherd of the Dead: Aura 1. Husks are immune to all damage while in the aura.

abilities.name: Incantation of Reclamation
abilities.rulesText: The Archivist summon a husk in a free space in range, then deals 1 piercing damage to all foes adjacent to that husk.

profiles.name: Grafter
profiles.description: Soul Surgeons skilled in the ways of soul grafting. In the final days of the doom, the empire resorted to all kinds of dark arts in an attempt to beat back the inevitable.
profiles.traitsText: Soul Surgeons skilled in the ways of soul grafting. In the final days of the doom, the empire resorted to all kinds of dark arts in an attempt to beat back the inevitable. Special Traits: Regeneration

abilities.name: Share Suffering
abilities.rulesText: The Grafter gains aura 1 in this stance. Each time a relict in the aura takes damage from an ability, they gain 2 vigor. This effect could trigger multiple times per ability. After that ability resolves, the Grafter sacrifices 2. At the start of its turn, the Grafter either exits this stance or sacrifices 4 to maintain it.

profiles.name: Embalmer
profiles.description: Priests charged with disposal of the physical form. In those days, the corpses were stacked like wheat after a harvest.
profiles.traitsText: Priests charged with disposal of the physical form. In those days, the corpses were stacked like wheat after a harvest.

abilities.name: Replace Black Communion with Necrotize
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: foes take 2 piercing damage. Self and allies gain vigor 2. Effect: The Embalmer gains Aura 2 until the start of its next turn. Foes that end their turn in the aura must sacrifice 2 and have a grasping dead space created under them, as per Black Communion. Chapter 2+ Unholy creates a grasping dead terrain effect under up to two of its targets after it resolves, as per Black Communion.

profiles.name: Soul Flayer
profiles.description: Dread priests that made up a secret police. In the Final Days, they forcibly conscripted the unlucky and criminal into the soul legions.
profiles.traitsText: Dread priests that made up a secret police. In the Final Days, they forcibly conscripted the unlucky and criminal into the soul legions.

abilities.name: Soul Flay
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range must sacrifice 2, once for every one of its adjacent allies, then is pacified.

abilities.name: Soul Shred
abilities.rulesText: Mark a foe in range. While marked, that foe gains Aura 2. Foes that end their turn in the aura must sacrifice 2. A foe can save to end this mark if they end their turn with no allies in the aura. Chapter 3

abilities.name: All gain Radiance of the Black Sun
abilities.rulesText: This character becomes immobile but gains Aura 2 until the start of its next turn. While the aura is active, Relict other than this character in the area cannot be reduced past 1 hp.

profiles.name: Immortalist
profiles.description: The higher caste of priests, each with a fragment of the Ur-spell embedded into their very beings.
profiles.traitsText: The higher caste of priests, each with a fragment of the Ur-spell embedded into their very beings. Eternal War: While the Immortalist is on the battlefield and not defeated, all relict’s Rise Again trait activates on a 3+.

abilities.name: Entombment of Iz
abilities.rulesText: The Immortalist entombs a character in range in a magical sarcophagus, summoning it in their space. Sarcophagus of Iz Object, Destructible (10 hp) Object effect: Shares space with a character. While sharing space with the sarcophagus, they must sacrifice 3 at the start of their turn and are immobile, but can otherwise be targeted normally. The Sarcophagus takes no damage from Relict and only 1 damage maximum from any ability from a foe inside of it. If a character is defeated in the sarcophagus, it crumbles and this effect ends.

abilities.name: Dark Redempta
abilities.rulesText: Target defeated relict in range and remove incapacitated. They stop being defeated and return to the battlefield with 50% hp, or 25% hp if they are an elite. They can act normally and take a turn starting next round. If defeated again, they disintegrate and are removed from the battlefield, and cannot be returned again.

profiles.name: GHUL
profiles.description: Some relict have a tiny fragment of self awareness, an existential anguish that manifests as a terrible hunger. This gives them more independence than their kin, allowing them to roam where the network is thin and warm bodies are numerous.
profiles.traitsText: Some relict have a tiny fragment of self awareness, an existential anguish that manifests as a terrible hunger. This gives them more independence than their kin, allowing them to roam where the network is thin and warm bodies are numerous. Special Traits: Phasing

abilities.name: Bloodfeed
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe take 2 damage again if not adjacent to any allies, and 2 damage again if bloodied.

abilities.name: Reality Flicker
abilities.rulesText: The Ghul or a relict in range 2 can teleport 3.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.rulesText: Effect: An adjacent foe sacrifices 3. If they are bloodied, they sacrifice 6 instead, and the Ghul gains evasion until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Terrorize
abilities.rulesText: Effect: A foe in range must save or become blinded+ and gains + 1 curse on all attacks and saves until it ends a turn adjacent to an ally, ending this effect. On a successful save, they are only blinded. Chapter 1+

profiles.name: Wailer
profiles.description: A starving ghul that stalks the living for days at a time. Somewhat pitiable, they long for warmth.
profiles.traitsText: A starving ghul that stalks the living for days at a time. Somewhat pitiable, they long for warmth.

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.rulesText: All adjacent foes must save or be forced to flee, shoving them 3 spaces in a direction of the Wailer’s choice, or 1 space on a successful save.

profiles.name: Arc Ghul
profiles.description: A ghul that has become unhinged from its own anguish, its body barely held together.
profiles.traitsText: A ghul that has become unhinged from its own anguish, its body barely held together.

abilities.name: Soul Shift
abilities.rulesText: The Ghul and any adjacent relict teleport 6. When they reappear, they must be placed adjacent if possible.

profiles.name: Twinsoul
profiles.description: A ghul that is the result of a network malfunction or the product of soul grafting, a twinsoul is a grotesque amalgam of two beings.
profiles.traitsText: A ghul that is the result of a network malfunction or the product of soul grafting, a twinsoul is a grotesque amalgam of two beings.

abilities.name: Twin Strike
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+2, twice. Miss: 2 damage, twice. Effect: The Twinsoul may backflip and fly 2 after this ability resolves. Chapter 2+ Life Drain gains range 4.

profiles.name: Devourer
profiles.description: A Ghul that has collapsed in on itself, becoming a sucking void and gaining the ability to rip away the essence of the living directly.
profiles.traitsText: A Ghul that has collapsed in on itself, becoming a sucking void and gaining the ability to rip away the essence of the living directly. Traits: Defiance

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.rulesText: Effect: The Ghul gains aura 2 until the start of its next turn. Foes that end their turn in the aura must sacrifice 25% of their max hp and become dazed. Dazed or blinded foes must sacrifice 50% of their max hp instead. Chapter 3 Drain Essence: When used against a foe at 25% hp or lower, Life Drain additionally reduces a foe to 1 hp, and the Ghul gains a vigor surge.

profiles.name: Stutterghast
profiles.description: A Ghul that has lived long enough and fed enough on the living that its existential anguish has begun to manifest into complete insanity. Its feral wailing cuts out periodically as it stutters throughout the network. evasion unless there’s two or more adjacent
profiles.traitsText: A Ghul that has lived long enough and fed enough on the living that its existential anguish has begun to manifest into complete insanity. Its feral wailing cuts out periodically as it stutters throughout the network. Dark Hollow: Deals bonus damage and has evasion unless there’s two or more adjacent characters.

abilities.name: Replace Reality Flicker with Stutter
abilities.rulesText: Repeat the following effect twice: The Stutterghast or an ally in range 2 teleports 2.

abilities.name: Stutterslash
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray, twice. Miss: fray, twice. Effect: Deals bonus damage to bloodied foes. Effect: Gains unerring against foes at exactly range 3. Effect: May teleport self and foe 2 spaces after this ability resolves.

profiles.name: WRAITH
profiles.description: Former slave wrights of the old empire, turned into living weapons to fight back against the Doom. Tethered to the network, these relict can float on the air with eerie grace, flickering in and out of existence.
profiles.traitsText: Former slave wrights of the old empire, turned into living weapons to fight back against the Doom. Tethered to the network, these relict can float on the air with eerie grace, flickering in and out of existence. Special Traits: Flying, Phasing

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.rulesText: , combo): On hit: [D]+2, twice. Miss or area effect: 2 damage, twice.

abilities.name: Soul Spark
abilities.rulesText: Creates a Soul Spark summon in free space in range. Round 3+: Two sparks. Soul Spark Summon, size 1, intangible Summon Effect: Foes adjacent to Soul Sparks are vulnerable+, and all damage deal to them becomes piercing. Area effect: If a foe ends their turn adjacent to a spark, it releases a small blast pulse centered on it, dealing 1 piercing damage twice to all foes Effect: The wraith can target the spark with Chain Lightning. If they do, it gains rebound and the spark triggers its area effect.

abilities.name: Unstable Charge
abilities.rulesText: Mark a foe in range. At the end of that foe's turn, they take 1 piercing damage, once, for every other character in range 2, then become vulnerable. Then, this mark ends. Chapter 1+

profiles.name: Arc Spectre
profiles.description: The most commonly seen wraith, held aloft by scouring arcs of lightning, with hands bound into power-amplifying gauntlets.
profiles.traitsText: The most commonly seen wraith, held aloft by scouring arcs of lightning, with hands bound into power-amplifying gauntlets.

abilities.name: Synaptic Storm
abilities.rulesText: Creates a massive network storm in range, which could overlap characters. The storm is a small blast terrain effect that is dangerous terrain, which relict ignore. Foes in the storm are vulnerable+. Using this ability again with an active storm can move the storm 2 spaces instead of replacing it. If used this way, it costs 1 action. At round 3+, moving a storm is a free action.

profiles.name: Chain Wraith
profiles.description: Blasphemers boiled alive in the pit of Iz. The chains used to bind them have combined with their beings in death.
profiles.traitsText: Blasphemers boiled alive in the pit of Iz. The chains used to bind them have combined with their beings in death.

abilities.name: Bind
abilities.rulesText: The Wraith chooses two characters anywhere in range 3 of each other, then teleports one of them adjacent to the other. Foes must save or be shattered. Becomes a free action if it targets two allied relict.

profiles.name: Rift Wraith
profiles.description: Some battle mages of the old world were granted the ability to tear at the walls between worlds, using the essence of the Doom itself to fight.
profiles.traitsText: Some battle mages of the old world were granted the ability to tear at the walls between worlds, using the essence of the Doom itself to fight.

abilities.name: Rift Step
abilities.rulesText: Teleport to the space of any pit in range.

abilities.name: Open Rift
abilities.rulesText: Create a pit under any character in range. Then, the Wraith may teleport that character to any other pit space in range 3 of their target’s location. Chapter 2+ Soul Sparks deal 1 piercing damage to all adjacent foe when summoned.

profiles.name: Abomination
profiles.description: A wraith created in the final days of the Imperium. The extreme methods used to create them left them unstable, undead weapons that were not meant to last long.
profiles.traitsText: A wraith created in the final days of the Imperium. The extreme methods used to create them left them unstable, undead weapons that were not meant to last long. Unstable: When defeated, explodes in a large blast area effect explosion centered on the wraith. Characters inside take piercing fray damage, twice, as an area effect. The wraith is then removed from the battlefield. Create a pit in the area it vacated

abilities.name: Scouring beam
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, line 10, width 2, pierce, Round 3+ only
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +fray twice. Miss or area effect: fray, twice. Effect: Foes in the area must save or be shattered. Effect: All objects in the path are removed. Chapter 3 Soul Spark explosions become a large blast

profiles.name: Blasphemy
profiles.description: Heretic Sorcerers who glimpsed the Black Sun. So powerful that they were entombed in specially bound iron coffins. The coffins float uncannily until broken open.
profiles.traitsText: Heretic Sorcerers who glimpsed the Black Sun. So powerful that they were entombed in specially bound iron coffins. The coffins float uncannily until broken open.

abilities.name: Iron Coffin
abilities.rulesText: Trigger: When bloodied. Effect: the coffin breaks open. The Blasphemy becomes intangible until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Obliterate Aether
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 3[D]+fray. Miss: [D]+fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage to characters at 50% hp or lower. Effect: Instead of dealing damage, character targeted sacrifices hp equal to the damage that would have been dealt. If a character is at 1 hp, they are instead instantly defeated.

profiles.name: SILENT ONE
profiles.description: Remnants of children, the elderly, or the mournful dead, who crave warmth and company.
profiles.traitsText: Remnants of children, the elderly, or the mournful dead, who crave warmth and company. Special Traits: Defiance Ethereal: Phasing, and has resistance unless adjacent to a foe.

abilities.name: Mournful Wail
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: Fray. Effect: Foe is pacified. Deals bonus damage to pacified foes and does not break the pacified condition.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.rulesText: Mark a foe in range 6. While marked, that foe deals half damage unless adjacent to an ally. If they end their turn adjacent to an ally, they can save to clear this mark.

abilities.name: Dreadful Sobbing
abilities.rulesText: The Silent one gains aura 1 until the start of its next turn. Characters in the aura are pacified+ and cannot be cured.

abilities.name: Possess
abilities.rulesText: The Silent one moves into and shares the space of an adjacent character, possessing them, with the following effects: • While possessing that character, they are intangible, share its space, and move when it moves. They can still take actions normally, but can’t leave the possessed character’s space. • The possessed character takes a free action at the end of its turn, which the Silent One chooses: • be shoved by the Silent one 3 spaces in any direction • deal [D] damage to an adjacent character • become pacified. • A character may save to remove this effect at the end of their turns after the above effect activates. When possession ends, the silent one appears in a free adjacent space.

profiles.name: STRIGOI
profiles.description: A ghul that has fed on enough life force to roam away from the dungeons, preying on villages and herd animals. These ghuls become feral in appearance and live in the dark holes of abandoned farmhouses, sheds, or shrines during the day, as much like other relict, they are harmed by sunlight.
profiles.traitsText: A ghul that has fed on enough life force to roam away from the dungeons, preying on villages and herd animals. These ghuls become feral in appearance and live in the dark holes of abandoned farmhouses, sheds, or shrines during the day, as much like other relict, they are harmed by sunlight. Special traits: Phasing Blood Hunger: Deals +2 damage with all abilities against bloodied foes.

abilities.name: Feral Frenzy
abilities.rulesText: On hit: Deal 2 damage three times. Miss: Once. Effect: May dash 2 before and after this action.

abilities.name: Bloody spit
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Deal fray damage. If foe has vigor, deal [D] instead, and they are dazed.

abilities.name: Feral Pounce
abilities.rulesText: The Strigoi gains stealth. Choose a foe in range 3. If, at the end of that foe’s next turn, they are still in range 3 of the Strigoi, it may teleport adjacent to them and deal 2 damage, three times, ending this effect and stealth..

profiles.name: AUTOMATA
profiles.description: War machines used to kill in the wars of the old Imperium, powered by soul amalgams. Ruthless and cold killing machines that trampled the lands of kin in times past.
profiles.traitsText: War machines used to kill in the wars of the old Imperium, powered by soul amalgams. Ruthless and cold killing machines that trampled the lands of kin in times past. Special Traits: Sturdy Automata: If this character attacks the same character as last turn, it deals bonus damage and gains +1 boon. This effect stacks. Empty Husk: This character becomes a height 1 object when defeated instead of a character, and cannot be returned to the battlefield.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolter
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, small blast, range 6, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray.

abilities.name: Full Auto
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, range 6, small blast, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: [D]+fray.

abilities.name: Charged Shield
abilities.rulesText: The Automata creates a 1 space terrain effect in range 3. Relict inside the terrain effect have cover, and it is dangerous and difficult terrain for foes. Using this ability again replaces it.

abilities.name: Discharge Clip
abilities.rulesText: The Automata shoots a line 5 area effect. Characters in the area take 1 piercing damage twice. If the area includes a Charged shield, deals 1 piercing damage four times instead.

profiles.name: FUSED
profiles.description: A massive relict made up of multiple, fused souls, unfortunates mashed together due to network malfunction or malicious soul grafting.
profiles.traitsText: A massive relict made up of multiple, fused souls, unfortunates mashed together due to network malfunction or malicious soul grafting. Special Traits: Size 2 Soul Mass: Can share space with other characters. Foes treat the space as difficult terrain, are slashed+ while inside, and have cover from the outside, but are otherwise targetable normally. Any foes that start their turn inside its space take fray damage. Foes that attempt to leave this character’s space by any means on their turn must save or become unable to exit it until the end of the current turn. Release passengers: When defeated, summon 4 relict husks in or adjacent to its space.

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.header: 2 actions, attack, medium blast, true strike, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage to weakened foes.

abilities.name: Melding Mass
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Fused may rush 2 after this ability. Characters inside the fused are shoved 3 in any direction. Collide: Characters are stunned.

abilities.name: Wail of Terror
abilities.rulesText: The Fused releases a horrible shriek in a medium blast area effect. Foes in the area are weakened, and take 2 damage once for every foe in the area, up to a maximum of five times.

profiles.name: IDOL
profiles.description: Walking statues of old saints, emperors, or legends, powered by curated soul amalgams.
profiles.traitsText: Walking statues of old saints, emperors, or legends, powered by curated soul amalgams. Special Traits: Size 2, Sturdy Heavy Armor: Resistant to abilities used from adjacent spaces Automata: If this character attacks the same character as last turn, it deals bonus damage and gains +1 boon. This effect stacks. Empty Husk: This character becomes a height 1 object when defeated instead of a character, and cannot be returned to the battlefield.

abilities.name: Heavy Mace
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 3[D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Loses curse against slashed foes.

abilities.name: Eye Beams
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: All foes are shoved 1 and take 2 damage.

abilities.name: Blade Sweep
abilities.rulesText: All adjacent foes are shoved 1 and slashed. Slashed foes also take fray damage.

abilities.name: Soul Nexus
abilities.rulesText: The Idol hardens and release an aura of swirling souls, gaining aura 2 until the start of its next turn. It becomes immobile and unstoppable. Relict in the aura become sturdy and gain resistance to damage from abilities used from outside the aura. Chapter 2+

profiles.name: LIFE HUNTER
profiles.description: Personal hunters of the Arkenliches, these undead monstrosities were custom crafted to hunt adventurers. Unlike other relict, they are nimble, somewhat intelligent, and independently minded.
profiles.traitsText: Personal hunters of the Arkenliches, these undead monstrosities were custom crafted to hunt adventurers. Unlike other relict, they are nimble, somewhat intelligent, and independently minded. Special Traits: Phasing Hand Picked: There can only ever be one Life Hunter on the battlefield

abilities.name: Nock
abilities.rulesText: The Life Hunter dashes 2.

abilities.name: Life Seeking Arrow
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Hit or miss, foe must also sacrifice 25% of their max hp. Effect: Cannot target characters in range 2.

abilities.name: Kick Off
abilities.rulesText: The Life Hunter flies 1. Before they fly, they may shove an adjacent character 1 space, then deal 2 damage to them if they are a foe. If they do, they fly 3 instead.

abilities.name: Liminal Darts
abilities.rulesText: Mark a foe in line of sight and range 10. At the end of that character’s turn, it takes [D] piercing damage if it’s not in cover from the Life Hunter, or just 2 piercing damage if it is. Then this mark ends.

profiles.name: REVENANT
profiles.description: A rogue ghul that has managed to re-house its soul in flesh again, usually by killing its former occupant. Revenants never last long, as the flesh decays too quickly to be of use.
profiles.traitsText: A rogue ghul that has managed to re-house its soul in flesh again, usually by killing its former occupant. Revenants never last long, as the flesh decays too quickly to be of use. Shed Flesh: After taking damage that bloodies it, becomes intangible until the start of its next turn as it wriggles out of its flesh. For the rest of combat, gains phasing and flying.

abilities.name: Bloody Hacking
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: Foe is dazed. Effect: Bloodied or dazed foes take 2 damage again after this ability resolves.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.rulesText: Effect: An adjacent foe sacrifices 3. If they are bloodied, they sacrifice 6 instead, and the Revenant gains evasion until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Horrible twitching
abilities.rulesText: The Revenant gains aura 1. Foes in the aura gain +1 curse on attacks. Allied Relict in the aura gain the dodge trait. The Revenant loses this stance if it ends its turn with no foes in the aura.

abilities.name: Bone Chilling Scream
abilities.rulesText: The Revenant releases a bone chilling scream, a burst 1 area effect. Characters in the area must save or take 2[D] +fray, or [D]+fray on a successful save. Chapter 3

profiles.name: IMMORTAL
profiles.description: Elite guard of the priest caste, entombed alive in their iron armor. Dark magic has sealed their armor so not even the aether of their soul can escape. Such is their undying vitality they don’t make any attempts at self-preservation. With their heavy glaives and black armor, they are a terrifying sight to even seasoned adventurers.
profiles.traitsText: Elite guard of the priest caste, entombed alive in their iron armor. Dark magic has sealed their armor so not even the aether of their soul can escape. Such is their undying vitality they don’t make any attempts at self-preservation. With their heavy glaives and black armor, they are a terrifying sight to even seasoned adventurers. Special Traits: Sturdy, Defiance Immortal Disregard: Attacks never miss the Immortal (turn any miss into a hit) Aura of Immortality: While Immortal is undefeated, it has Aura 2. Relict without this trait inside cannot be reduced past 1 HP.

abilities.name: Bloody Fuller
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+2. Miss: 2. E ffect: Shove 1. Effect: Deals damage again to attack target and all foes adjacent to the attack target, hit or miss, equal to 2 times the round number

abilities.name: March of the Imperium
abilities.rulesText: Repeat the following effect twice: either the Immortal or an adjacent ally rushes 1, then deals 2 damage to all adjacent foes and shoves them 1. This can affect the same foe more than once.

abilities.name: Arken Impaler
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe is shoved 3. The Immortal rushes after the target, following it, ending adjacent if possible. Collide: foe is also slashed and takes fray damage.

abilities.name: Supreme Formation
abilities.rulesText: All allies everywhere may rush 1 space closer to this character. Bloodied allies gain 2 vigor.

abilities.name: Execute
abilities.rulesText: A foe in range at 25% HP or lower must save. On a failed save, they are defeated, ignoring all other effects. On a successful save, they are reduced to 1 hp.

profiles.name: ROYAL GUARD
profiles.description: Multi-limbed, multi-bodied warriors fused together by dark alchemy and soul grafting at their entombing to protect the old arken- emperors in death. The four fight as one, overwhelming the defenses of even the most canny fighters.
profiles.traitsText: Multi-limbed, multi-bodied warriors fused together by dark alchemy and soul grafting at their entombing to protect the old arken- emperors in death. The four fight as one, overwhelming the defenses of even the most canny fighters. HP: 80 Special Traits: Size 2 Elite: Takes 2 turns

abilities.name: Vortex
abilities.rulesText: All characters in range 2 of the royal guard are shoved 1 towards or away from it.

abilities.name: Battalion of Limbs
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, medium blast, multimark, true strike
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: The Royal Guard marks their attack target. This mark can be placed more than once and stacks indefinitely. For each stack of the mark, this attack deals +3 damage on hit or miss. A character can save against this mark at the end of their turn to clear all stacks, but only if they are not in range 2 of the royal guard.

abilities.name: Blade Shield
abilities.rulesText: An ally in range is marked by the Royal Guard. While marked and adjacent to the Royal Guard, they gain +1 boon on saves and resistance.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.header: 1 action, true strike, small blast, range 6
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Fray damage and characters must save or be slashed.

abilities.name: Wind of Obliteration
abilities.rulesText: Repeat this effect three times: Effect: The Royal Guard rushes 1, then deals [D] to all adjacent characters, then shoves them 1. It gains phasing during this action and must take each of these dashes in the same direction. Characters can be affected multiple times.

profiles.name: WARMECH
profiles.description: Multi-limbed metal war machine, powered by soul amalgamation. Kills dispassionately and with overwhelming force, using weapons that blight the land and scour the soil. Many of these machines are buried in the soil of Arden Eld, even outside the ruins, and can remain dormant for centuries.
profiles.traitsText: Multi-limbed metal war machine, powered by soul amalgamation. Kills dispassionately and with overwhelming force, using weapons that blight the land and scour the soil. Special Traits: Size 2, Sturdy Automata: If this character attacks the same character as last turn, it deals bonus damage and gains +1 boon. This effect stacks. Empty Husk: This character becomes a 2x2 series of height 1 objects when defeated instead of a character, and cannot be returned to the battlefield. Elite: Takes 2 turns

abilities.name: Plasma bomb
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each round, the Warmech fires a plasma bomb into the air, targeted on any visible space. The bomb marks a medium blast area visible to all characters. At the end of the round, the bomb comes down as an area effec t. Characters in the area take piercing fray damage and are shattered. Any character in the center must save or also be stunned. The targeted space then becomes a pit. The Warmech is immune to its own bombs.

abilities.name: Focus Beam
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Attack target is shattered. Deals bonus damage to characters in range 3.

abilities.name: Charge Boost
abilities.rulesText: The Warmech flies 3. When it lands, adjacent characters are shoved 1

abilities.name: Seekers
abilities.rulesText: , combo): A rea effect. Foes take 2 piercing damage. Foes at exactly range 3 take 2 piercing damage twice.

abilities.name: Falling Stars
abilities.rulesText: All foes outside of range 3 take 2 piercing damage, ignoring cover, as an area effect.

abilities.name: Side Cannons
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes are shoved 2. Collide: Foe takes fray damage. Chapter 2+

profiles.name: IZENGHAST
profiles.description: Stuttering horrors born of living souls that have been trapped in the Relict system - the remnants of adventurers or unlucky wanderers who went too deep in an arkenruin. evasion unless there’s two or more adjacent
profiles.traitsText: Stuttering horrors born of living souls that have been trapped in the Relict system - the remnants of adventurers or unlucky wanderers who went too deep in an arkenruin. Special Traits: Phasing Elite: Takes 2 turns Dark Hollow: Deals bonus damage and has evasion unless there’s two or more adjacent characters. Surreality: When this character would be defeated, instead becomes intangible until the end of its next turn, then removes itself from the battlefield. It cannot return.

abilities.name: Stutter
abilities.rulesText: Repeat the following effect twice: The Stutterghast or an adjacent ally teleports 1.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] damage. Miss or area effect: 1 damage. Effect: All foes in the area must sacrifice 4 after this ability resolves.

abilities.name: Horrid slashing
abilities.rulesText: The Stutterghast teleports 1, then teleports 1. Each time, it deals 2 damage to an adjacent foe. Bloodied foes are dazed.

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.rulesText: All foes in range must save or be forced to flee, shoving them 2 spaces in a direction of the Izenghast’s choice, or 1 space on a successful save.

abilities.name: Soul Drain
abilities.header: 2 actions, usable only on bloodied foes
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe sacrifices 25% of their maximum hp. The Izenghast or another relict in range 3 is cured.

profiles.name: ARKITEK
profiles.description: Machine-priests and designers of the deep arkenruins, the sealed library-vaults intended to let the empire wait out the Doom in undead form. Masters of the labyrinth, the mechanisms of the dungeons themselves bend and contort themselves to protect them. resistance.
profiles.traitsText: Machine-priests and designers of the deep arkenruins, the sealed library-vaults intended to let the empire wait out the Doom in undead form. Masters of the labyrinth, the mechanisms of the dungeons themselves bend and contort themselves to protect them. VIT: 8 HP: 64 Special Traits: Defiance Elite: Takes 2 turns Stoneskin: While adjacent to an object, has resistance.

abilities.name: Deep Call
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: the Arkitek may summon a height 1 dungeon ruin object adjacent to its target.

abilities.name: Reconfigure
abilities.rulesText: The Arkitek removes and places any number of objects created by it or another character in range to any other free space in range. Characters standing on or trapped inside an object are moved and placed with it.

abilities.name: Pillar of Iz
abilities.rulesText: The Arkitek summons a Pillar of Iz in range. It can be summoned under characters. Pillar of Iz Height 2 object, destructible (5 hp) Object effect: Aura 1. Inside the aura, relict characters have resistance and foes are sealed+.

abilities.name: Entombment of Iz
abilities.rulesText: The Arkitek entombs a character in range in a magical sarcophagus, summoning it in their space. Sarcophagus of Iz Object, Destructible (10 hp) Object effect: Shares space with a character. While sharing space with the sarcophagus, they must sacrifice 3 at the start of their turn and are immobile, but can otherwise be targeted normally. The Sarcophagus takes no damage from Relict and only 1 damage maximum from any ability from a foe inside of it. If a character is defeated in the sarcophagus, it crumbles and this effect ends. Chapter 3

profiles.name: ATROPHIC GRAVE
profiles.description: A massive amalgam of souls, created when the Ur-spell reached and processed large crowds of the public, hiding for safety from the apocalyptica outside and completely unaware of their impending immortalization.
profiles.traitsText: A massive amalgam of souls, created when the Ur-spell reached and processed large crowds of the public, hiding for safety from the apocalyptica outside and completely unaware of their impending immortalization. HP: 80 Special Traits: Defiance, Sturdy, Size 3 Trait modifications: This character lacks the Guard trait Soul Mass: Can share space with other characters. Foes treat the space as difficult terrain, are slashed+ while inside, and have cover from the outside, but are otherwise targetable normally. Any foes that start their turn inside its space take fray damage. Foes that attempt to leave the Grave’s space by any means must save or become unable to exit it until the end of the current turn. Shed Mass: At the start of its turn, the Grave summons a husk in a free adjacent space. When the Grave is bloodied, it summons 2 husks instead.

abilities.name: Hungry Dead
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: All characters in range 2 are shoved 1 towards the grave, which could shove them inside of it.

abilities.name: Tendrils
abilities.rulesText: Characters in range of the Grave are shoved 1 towards or away from it. The Grave can choose for each character. Bloodied characters are shoved 2 instead.

abilities.name: Vomit Lightning
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes take 2 damage once for each foe in the area, up to a maximum of three times.

abilities.name: One Hundred Hands
abilities.rulesText: The Grave rushes 1 spaces.

abilities.name: Two Hundred Hands
abilities.rulesText: The Grave rushes 2 spaces. •

abilities.name: Three Hundred Hands
abilities.rulesText: The Grave rushes 3 spaces. •

abilities.name: Cacophonous Consumption
abilities.rulesText: Foes inside the Grave must save, then they take 5 damage, five times. If they succeed the save, they take 3 damage, five times instead.

profiles.name: I. VESSEL KNIGHT
profiles.description: Black-armored conqueror knights of incredible power that were dispatched alone to lands not conquered by the Arken to conduct diplomacy - at the tip of a sword if need be. There were forty of these knights, ten for each of the cardinal directions. Each was a hero of unparalleled strength, their name recorded in the annals of the imperial muster, and blessed by the Emperor. While they still lived, these knights were marked by dark ritual, their very essences bound to their armor so that they could continue their duty even in death or after mortal injury. During the Doom, they all succumbed, but this did not stop them from carrying out their orders. Repeated death has stripped most of them of their sense. Now they are vaporous husks - hollow iron shells filled with dust and a sense of loathsome purpose. When the ruins rise, they rise from their graves and call forth armies, slaughtering and conquering in the name of an empire that no longer exists until they are beaten and sealed again.

abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, this character may clear a status or mark. Malice: After they attack, the Vessel knight marks their target, granting a stack of malice. • Malice stacks indefinitely and can mark any number of characters. • At the end of their turn, a character sacrifices 3 for every stack of Malice they have. • If a character suffering from Malice doesn’t attack during their turn, at the end of their turn, they reduce their stacks of Malice by 2 before sacrificing, which could clear them. • It can also be cleared by anything that clears a mark, but doing so only clears one at a time. Beyond Death: When defiance activates, roll a d6. On a 3+, this character immediately regains defiance. Divine damage bypasses this trait. Phases: The Knight switches to phase 2 when bloodied. The Knight has the following ability series in all phases:

abilities.name: Darklight cleaver
abilities.header: 1 action, true strike, attack, range 2, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+ 1. Miss: 1. Effect: Foe gains +1 Malice.

abilities.name: Darklight splitter
abilities.header: 1 action, true strike, line 5, attack, range 2, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D] +1 and +1 Malice. Miss or area effect: 1 damage and +1 Malice.

abilities.name: Darklight crusher
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray and +1 Malice. Miss: [D]+fray and +1 Malice.

abilities.name: Dark Strength
abilities.rulesText: Rush 2, then an adjacent foe is shoved 2 spaces. Collide: foe is slashed. Slashed foes are stunned. Phase I:

abilities.name: Rage of Iz
abilities.rulesText: Effect: The Vessel roars, and a foe of its choice in range 6 feels the ground trembling beneath their feet. At the end of that character’s turn, roll 1d6. The knight summons either a pit (1-3) or a height 1 dark light spire object (4-6) under that foe. The ground erupts in a small blast area effect centered on this terrain, dealing fray damage to all characters.

abilities.name: Despair
abilities.rulesText: The knight charges a character in range 3 with dark energy, creating a small blast area on them. At the end of that character’s next turn, they must sacrifice 3 for every space of the cross not occupied by themselves, an ally, or a summon. Then, they gain +1 Malice.

abilities.name: Damocles
abilities.rulesText: The knight chooses a character in range. At the end of the very next turn, if that character is still in range of the knight, it removes itself from the battlefield, then places itself adjacent to them and may make the next of its Darklight attack series against them. Phase II: When bloodied, the Knight becomes intangible until the end of the current turn, then transitions into Phase II. It ignores all damage that put it into its phase transition past its bloodied value. As phase I, but: Spectral form: Gains phasing, flying, and speed 6

abilities.name: Dispersal
abilities.rulesText: Trigger: The knight is damaged by an ability. Effect: The knight may teleport up to 3 spaces

abilities.name: Soul Cleaver
abilities.rulesText: Effect: All foes in range take 2 divine damage. Each time this ability is used again this combat, increase its damage by +1.

profiles.name: II. ARKENLICH
profiles.description: Designers of the Ur-spell and arch-priests of the Dark Sun, these ancient warrior-necromancers were embalmed and entombed even before the final death of the empire, their souls bound into specially prepared vessels so they could carry out the great work of the old emperors uninterrupted by the frailties of mortality. Their bronze sarcophagi are engraved with their titles and names and their eyes are sealed with gold. Though the process left their minds largely intact, the long dark and centuries in contact with the anguished souls trapped in the Relict network have left most of them insane. Most of them lie dreaming in fitful nightmares until awakened by unlucky adventurers.
profiles.traitsText: Designers of the Ur-spell and arch-priests of the Dark Sun, these ancient warrior-necromancers were embalmed and entombed even before the final death of the empire, their souls bound into specially prepared vessels so they could carry out the great work of the old emperors uninterrupted by the frailties of mortality. abilities.name: Juggernaut
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, this character may clear a status or mark. Phases: At round 3 and every third round thereafter, the Lich uses Utterances of the Crawling Dead. Phase I:

abilities.name: Thy Tribute is Demanded
abilities.rulesText: At the start of each round, the Lich severs part of a foe’s soul in range 4, placing it in a free space adjacent to that character.

profiles.name: Soul Fragment
profiles.description: Wicked and Utterances of the Crawling Dead.
profiles.traitsText: Summon, immobile, intangible Summon Effect: Each soul fragment is tied to a specific character. Characters adjacent to any soul fragment are vulnerable+. Additionally, fragments can be affected by the Lich’s round actions Annihilation of the Wicked and Utterances of the Crawling Dead.

abilities.name: Annihilation of the Wicked
abilities.rulesText: At the end of each round, the Lich wreaks the battlefield with scathing ur-magic. All foes on the battlefield take 1 piercing damage, once, for every other foe or soul fragment that they share a row or column with on the battlefield grid map (imagine it like a big cross centered on each character).

abilities.name: Witness the Coming Terror
abilities.rulesText: The Lich reveals a glimpse of a possible dark future to a character in range. That character becomes vulnerable from the sheer stress and must save or become stunned. If there are none of its allies in range 2, that character also sacrifices 25% of their maximum hp. Offer Obeisance before Thy Proper Lords (1 action, end turn, 1/round): The Lich releases a word of powerful Ur-magic, ordering all foes to kneel. Foes can choose: either kneel and become immobile for the rest of the current round, or be shoved 2 away from the Lich. Collide: Foe is vulnerable.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.rulesText: Mark a foe in range. While marked, that foe deals half damage unless adjacent to an ally. If they end their turn adjacent to an ally, they may save to clear this mark.

abilities.name: Master of the Four Winds
abilities.rulesText: The Lich either teleports 4, or removes itself from the battlefield, then places itself in free space in range 2.

abilities.name: The Inevitable Corruption of Flesh
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes in the line take 2 piercing damage, then each foe deals 1 piercing damage to all its adjacent allies. Characters adjacent to more than one foe in this effect can be damaged multiple times.

abilities.name: The Word of Beckoning Cowards
abilities.rulesText: Area effect: Foes in the line take 2 piercing damage. The first foe in the line is shoved 2 towards the Lich, or as far as possible.

abilities.name: Profane
abilities.header: 1 actions, attack, range 4, small blast, pierce, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray.

abilities.name: Bolide
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, range 6, large blast, combo
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Character in the center space is shattered. Then create a height 1 smoking meteor object in free space adjacent to them •

abilities.name: Black Blade of Iz
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray, twice and shove 1. Miss: fray damage, twice. Effect: Deals bonus damage vs shattered or vulnerable foes. Phase II (round 3, 6, 9+): As phase I, but: Utterances of the Crawling Dead: At the start of the round, the lich begins incanting. It chooses a foe, who gains aura 2, and becomes immune to being shoved by the lich’s abilities. Every other part of the battlefield begins to shift with crawling darkness. At the end of the round, the battlefield erupts. All foes not in the safe zone marked by the aura must sacrifice 50% of their maximum hp. If any of a character’s soul fragments are not in the safe zone, they must additionally sacrifice 25% of their max hp per soul fragment caught outside the area.

profiles.name: III. DREAD LORDS
profiles.description: The Legions of the Arken were always ruled in triumvirate, each legion headed by three of its mightiest lord commanders. At the fall of the Empire, these minor Arkenlords were entombed with their troops, buried alive under rubble, scoured by dread magics and left smoking on the battlefields, or burned alive in the smoking cities of the Arken. Their immortalization crystallized their hatred at their failure to protect the empire, honing it to a razor's edge. Now, in death, they lie dreaming, entangled in nightmares of ceaseless bloodlust and brutal conquest. The priests of the Black Sun work endlessly at their resurrection, for when the Dread Lords can be awakened, their wrath is terrible, and their ambition endless.

abilities.name: Eternal Lordship
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, clear a status or mark on one of the Lords. Triumvirate: This Legend is made up of three powerful undead lords. Each is a unique character and tracks statuses and effects separately, but all three share the same health pool and become bloodied when their total health is at 50%. When reduced to 0 hp, all three are defeated simultaneously. Imperium: When this legend takes a turn, it acts with one of the three Lords. It cannot take another turn with a Lord in a round until all three have acted. However, abilities with an Imperium effect grant the two lords who are not currently acting an additional effect. Phases: At the start of each round, one of the Dread Lords can use its Round Action, with a different Lord’s round action each round, until all three have used their Round Action. At round 3 and every three rounds thereafter, the Lords use Eternal Imperium. ETERNAL IMPERIUM (Round 3, 6, etc) At the start of this round, all three Lords use their Round actions simultaneously. LORDS:

profiles.name: LORD EVICTOR
profiles.description: Lord of the Center, the Black Iron Lord. Arken nobles granted this title were renowned and greatly feared generals tasked with controlling and holding the center mass of a combat, and in other times protecting the homelands of the Empire and keeping order by rooting out seditionists and rebels. In life, they crushed all before them with cold-hearted brutality. In death, there is little difference.
profiles.traitsText: Lord of the Center, the Black Iron Lord. abilities.name: Strength of Hell
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Evictor prepares to strike a seismic blow. At the end of the round, they slam the battlefield, affecting all characters in range 3 from them. Characters take differing effects depending on how far away they are from the Lord Evictor: • adjacent: 3 damage, three times, and shoved 3 • 2 spaces: 2 damage, twice, and shoved 2 • 3 spaces: 1 damage and shoved 1 Actions

abilities.name: Dread March
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Evictor rushes 1, then shoves all adjacent foes 1. Imperium: The other lords can also rush 1.

abilities.name: Blood Rush
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss: fray. Effect: The Lord Evictor may rush 1 before this attack. Effect: The Lord swings their weapon in a massive arc after this ability resolves. Foes adjacent to the Lord take 2 damage again and are shoved 1.

abilities.name: Crush Peon
abilities.rulesText: An adjacent foe is picked up and crushed by the Lord Evictor. Remove them from the battlefield as they are hurled into the air, then smashed down in any space in range 2, returning them. They are slashed. Slashed characters are stunned instead. Imperium: If the other one or two lords are in range 3 of the target’s landing point, they juggle the target with attacks before they land, each dealing 2 piercing damage.

abilities.name: Break Earth
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Evictor smashes the ground with the hilt of their weapon, dealing fray damage to and weakening a character in range. Weakened characters are stunned. Imperium: If another Lord is in range 3, the Lord Evictor can cause a shockwave that creates a height 1 debris object underneath that Lord, or raises the height of such an object by 1.

abilities.name: Dark Grip
abilities.rulesText: A foe at or further away than range 4 must save. On a successful save, they are shoved 2 spaces towards the Lord Evictor. On a failed save, they are shoved until adjacent, or as far as possible.

profiles.name: LORD PRELICTOR
profiles.description: Lord of the Right Flank, the Pure Silver Lord. Arken nobles granted this title were wrights and warrior-philosophers of great power. They were master strategists and quartermasters, as skilled with the organization and upkeep of the legions as they were with scathing the battlefield with blasts of primal magic. In death, they are able to muster and catalogue the dead with the same ruthless efficiency as they did in life.

abilities.name: Muster the Dead
abilities.rulesText: At the start of the round, the Lord Prelictor summons three wailing souls, in free space anywhere on the battlefield not adjacent to a foe. Wailing Soul Summon, size 1, intangible Summon effect: Foes adjacent to souls are vulnerable+ and all damage dealt to them becomes piercing. If a foe collides with a soul, they release a large blast shriek area effect centered on them, dealing 2 piercing damage to all foes inside, then removing the soul. Actions

abilities.name: Master of the Secret Places
abilities.rulesText: The Lord swaps the positions of any or all of the three Lords, removing and placing them.

abilities.name: Imperishable Star
abilities.header: 1 action, attack, pierce, range 5, large blast
abilities.rulesText: On hit: [D]+fray. Miss or area effect: fray. Effect: Create a pit under the attack target.

abilities.name: Yawning Void
abilities.rulesText: Summon a pit in a free space in range. Characters that start or end their turn in the pit can be teleported by the Lord Prelictor to any other pit created by this ability or Imperishable Star. Imperium: The Lord Prelictor can then teleport another Lord in range 3 2 spaces.

abilities.name: Drain Essence
abilities.rulesText: Area Effect: Foes inside take 2 piercing damage and must save or become pacified.

abilities.name: Dark Astra
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Prelictor marks itself or another Lord with a ward of energy. That Lord gains 10 vigor. When this vigor is destroyed, or at the end of the round, the ward explodes, ending this mark. Foes in a large blast area effect centered on the targeted Lord take 2 piercing damage twice and must save or be shattered. A character also loses this vigor if the mark is transferred, but it doesn’t cause the ward to explode.

profiles.name: LORD VEXATOR
profiles.description: Lord of the Left Flank, the True Bronze Lord. Arken nobles granted this title were rangers, scouts, and vanguards tasked with scouting new lands for conquest and with the purgation and subjugation of barbarians. Their bloodlust and cruelty was unparalleled.
profiles.traitsText: Lord of the Left Flank, the True Bronze Lord. Arken nobles granted this title were rangers, scouts, and vanguards tasked with scouting new lands for conquest and with the purgation and subjugation of barbarians. Their bloodlust and cruelty was unparalleled. Special Traits: Skirmisher, Dodge

abilities.name: Punishment of Heaven
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Vexator prepares to shoot a massive flurry of bolts from a greatbow at all characters close to it. At the end of the round, they release a flurry of shots, affecting all characters in range 3 from them. Characters take differing effects depending on how far away they are to the Lord Vexator: • adjacent: 1 damage and shove 1 • 2 spaces: 2 damage, twice, and shoved 2 • 3 spaces: 3 damage, three times and shoved 3 Actions

abilities.name: Raid
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Vexator leaps and flies up to 3 spaces. Imperium: If they land next to another Lord, both Lords can leap and fly up to 3 spaces again, then each can deal 2 damage to an adjacent foe after landing.

abilities.name: Scathe Barbarians
abilities.rulesText: On hit: 2[D]+fray. Miss: [D]+fray. Effect: Deals bonus damage for every difference in height between the Lord Vexator and their target. If the difference is 2+, this ability gains unerring, foe takes 2 damage twice again and is dazed.

abilities.name: The Language of the Shadows
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Vexator gains stealth, and adjacent foes must save or become blinded. Imperium: Another Lord in range 3 gains stealth.

abilities.name: Essence Arrow
abilities.rulesText: The Lord Vexator shoots a line 6 area effect. Foes inside take fray damage. Imperium: If the Lord Evictor is caught in the area, the area gains true strike, and foes in the line are then shoved 1 towards or away from the Lord Vexator. If the Lord Prelictor is caught in the line, the arrow deals 2 piercing damage twice instead.

profiles.name: Brawler Beast
profiles.description: Beasts with thick hides, strong limbs, and monstrous tempers. These dungeon-dwelling beasts enforce their territory through raw aggression and muscle. The energies of the dungeons have given them prodigious size. collide: foes are is weakened. Weakened foes take
